verses.text: Benyamin gama Anathoth khua a teng siampi innkuan pana khat ahi Hilkiyah’ tapa Yeremyah’ thugente ahi hi;
Amon’ tapa Yoshiyah, Yahdah kumpi a sep a kum sawm le thum thumna kumin Yeremyah tungah Yahweh’ kammal tung hi.

Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yahyakim in a uk a kipan, Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Zedekyah uk zawh a kum sawm le khatna a bei hun, tua kum a Kha Nga-na ah Yerusalem mite sal-a a paikhiat dong Yahweh in hopih hi.
Yahweh’ kammal kei tungah hong tungin a gen inah:
“Gil sungah kong bawl ma-in nang kong thei khin zo a, nang na suah ma-in kong suansuah khin hi; minamte tungah kamsang dingin nang kong seh khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, “Aa, Yahweh ka Pa! En dih in, naupang ka hi a, thu ka gen thei kei hi! “ ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, “Naupang ka hi, ci kei in! Bang hang hiam cihleh nang kong sawlna khempeuh ah na pai ding a, kong thupiak bangbangin na gen ding hi!
Nang hong hu dingin nangmah hong ompih ka hih manin lau kei in, Yahweh in ci hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in a khut zankhia-in ka kam kong lawng a, Yahweh in keima kiangah, “En in, Ka thute na kam sungah ka koih khin hi.
En in! Minamte leh kumpigamte tungah a botkhia ding leh a phel ding, a susia ding leh a paai khia ding, a lam ding leh a suan dingin tuni-in nang kong koih khin hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua bek tham loin, keima kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tung a, “Yeremyah aw, bang mu na hi hiam?” hong ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, “Almond kung panin a hiang khat ka mu hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, “Hoih takin na mu hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka thugente a tangtun na dingin Kei zong ka en gige hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ kammal a nih veina hong tung a, “Bang mu na hi hiam?” hong ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, “Beel a so khat ka mu a, leilu lam panin hong awnsuk hi,” ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, “Leilu lam panin hih gam sunga tengte khempeuh tungah siatna kikhahkhia ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh en in, leilu lam gam khempeuh ka sam a, amaute hong pai ding uh hi; amaute in Yerusalem a kiimkot kulhpi khempeuh bul leh Yahdah khuapite khempeuh nai-ah ahi a, Yerusalem kulh kongpi lutna ah ahi zongin a kumpi tokhom ciat phut ding uh hi.
Kei hong taisan-in, a kikham pasiante tungah paknamtui hal uh a, amau khut tawh a bawlsa nate bia-in a gitloh gamtatna khempeuh uh tawh kizui-in amaute tungah ka thukhennate ka genkhia ding hi.
Nang na hih leh, kiging khol in! Dingto inla, amaute kiangah nang tunga kong gen khempeuh gen in. Amaute hangin lauthawng kei in, na lauthawng leh amaute mai-ah nang kong lauthawngsak ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh en in, hih gam buppi langah ding dingin, Yahdah kumpite, a uliante, a siampite, a gam mite langpan dingin tuni-in a muanhuai khuapi, sikkhuam leh sumngo kulhpi khat-in nang kong bawl hi.
Amaute in nang hong do ding uh a, ahih hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kong cih inah, nang hong hu dingin nang kong ompih hi,” hong ci hi.
Yahweh’ kammal kei tungah hong tungin a gen inah:

“Pai inla, Yerusalem mite zak dingin va tangko in, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na khangno lai-a nong kipiakna, na mothak lai, a kikhawh lohna gam sehnel gam sungah Kei nong zuih lai-a Kei nong itnate ka phawk hi.
Yahweh tungah Israyl siangtho-in, a lak gah masa ahi hi. Amah a ne peuhmah a mawh suak ding a, amaute tungah siatna tung ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi, ci-in va gen in,” hong ci hi.
Yaaqob’ innkuan leh Israyl’ innkuan khempeuh aw, Yahweh’ kammal za un.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: “Na pu na pate uh kei kiang panin gamla pi ah paikhia-in, bangmah-a kimang lo teng zuih-in nei-in, a mawknapi a suah nadingun na pu na pate un keima sungah bang mawhna mu ahi uh hiam?

Amaute in, ‘Egypt gam panin hong paikhiatpih, sehnel gam leh dum lak, leikeuna leh sihna liim, kuamah in a tot lohna gam leh kuama ten lohna mun tawnin gamlak ah a hong makaih Yahweh koi-ah om ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dong uh ahi hiam?
A gah leh a hoih nate ne dingin Keimah in huan a bang gam ah note kong paipih hi. Ahih hangin na lut uh ciangin, note in Ka gam ninsakin, Ka neihsa gam a kihhuai na suaksak uh hi.

Siampite in, “Yahweh koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci-in dong lo uh hi. Thukham a lenkip mite nangawn in kei hong thei lo uh hi! Biakna siate in zong kei tungah hong khial uh hi; kamsangte in Baal’ min tawh kamsang uh a, kimanna nei lo nate zuih-in nei uh hi!
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in kong cih inah, note kong mawhsak beh lai ding a, na tate uh tate zong ka mawhsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Chittim tuipi gei kantan unla, va en dih un; Kedar ah mi sawl unla, limtakin ngaihsun un; tua bang thu a om ngei hiam, mu un.
Minam khat, a pasiante in vangliatna nei lo napi-in a pasian uh khel ngei ahi hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in bangmah-a kimang lo nate khekna-in amau Minthanna zuak uh hi.
Vantungte aw, hih thu ah kilat unla, lau mahmah un; laulua-in liing un, Yahweh in ci hi:
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka mite in siatna nih bawl khin uh hi—amaute in Nuntakna Tuinak keimah hong taisan khin uh a, tuikhuk keh-in tui a vung thei amau tuikhuk ding totawm uh hi.
Israyl sal ahi hiam? Sila nate ahi zenzen hiam? Hilo ahih leh bang hangin galte in luh gawp zo ahi hiam?
Humpi khanglaite in amah hawkin, ngik uh hi; Amaute in a gam gam simtham suah uh a, a khuapite halin kuamah teng lo hi.
Noph; Memphis, leh Tahpanhes mite in zong na lu tunga kumpi lukhu sukham hi.
Yahweh na Pa in lampi ah nang hong makaih laitakin amah na nusiatna manin hih teng nang tungah hong tung hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, Sihor tuite a dawn dingin Egypt ah na paina tawh bang ngah na hi hiam? Euphrates Gun tuite dawn dingin Assyria ah paina tawh bang ngah na hi hiam?

Nangma gitlohna mah in hong puahpha ding a, na nungtolhna mah in nang hong thuhilh ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh na Pa nong nusiat ciang, nang sungah Kei nong zahtakna a om loh ciangin a nop hethet lohna thei inla, phawk in, vanglian Pa Yahweh in kong ci hi.

Sawtpek lai-in na hakkol kong kuaihtansak a, hong kihenna kong bottatsak a, nangmah in, ‘Na thu ka palsat kei ding hi!’ na ci hi. Ahih hangin mual sang tung teng leh singliim nuai tengah paktatin na lum kawikawi hi.
Tua hinapi-in a kiteelteel leenggui ci hoih khatin nang kong suan hi. Bang hangin Kei aa dingin gamlak leenggui kungsia hong suak na hi hiam?
Vuttui tawh kisilin, satpiang tampi na zang zongin Ka mai-ah na mawhna nin om lai veve ding hi, Yahweh i Pa in ci hi.
Bang hangin, ‘Ka nin kei a, Baal-te nung ka zui kei hi!’ ci thei ding na hi hiam? Ben-Hinnom Kuam ah na gamtatna mu in! Na gamtatsate ngaihsun in! A suktai a totai kalaoh huk na bang hi;

Gam sung nuam a sa gam laa in a huk laitakin huih a dik vatvat tawh na kibang hi. A huk laitak kua in kham zo ding ahi hiam? Amah a zong nuam peuhpeuh in gim kul se loin, a huk hunin ngah lel ding uh hi.

Na khe-a khedap a siat dong, dangtakin na dang a keu dongin tai kei in. Ahih hangin nangmah in, ‘Hilo hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh gamdangte; pasiante, ka it a, amau nung ka zui teitei ding hi,’ na ci hi.
Gutapa a kitheih ciangin a mai a zum mah bangin Israyl’ Innkuan maizum ding hi; Amaute, a kumpite, a uliante, a siampite, a kamsangte a maizum ding uh hi.

Amaute in singtawng khat kiangah, ‘Nang ka pa na hi hi!’ ci a, suangtum khat kiangah, ‘Nang sung panin ka suak hi!’ na ci uh hi. Aw, amaute in Kei hong nungngatsan uh a, a mai hong ngat kei uh hi. Ahih hangin haksatna a tuah hun uh ciangin amaute kiko-in, ‘Tho inla, kote hong hon in,’ a ci ding uh hi.

No aa dinga na bawl uh na pasiante koi-ah om ahi hiam? A sem thei ahih leh, amaute thosak inla, na haksat hun uh ciangin kihonkhia sak un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah aw, na khuapi pha zahzah pasian na nei hi.
Bang hangin Kei hong mawhsak na hi uh hiam? Note khempeuh in Kei langah thu na palsat uh hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Na tate uh ka sat hangin puahphatna sang lo uh a, a mawknapi suak hi. A susia gawp humpinelkai bangin na namsaute un na kamsangte ne tum hi.

No khangthakte aw, Yahweh’ Thukham mu un! Israyl aa dingin gamlak leh khuamial gam tawh kibang ngei ka hi hiam? Bang hangin Ka mite in, ‘Tote ka hi uh hi; ka suakta uh hi! Nang kiangah kong pai nawn kei ding uh hi!’ ci uh ahi hiam?
Nungak khat in a kizepna suang manphate mangngilh ngei a, mothak khat in a mopuan mangngilh ngei ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in Ka mite in ni tampi sim zawh lohin Kei hong mangngilh uh hi.
Itna zon theih nading na lampi sialzia na siam mahmah hi. Tua thu hangin, numei siapente nangawn in nang kiang panin lampi hong sin hi.

Na puan tungah zong mawh nei lo mizawngte’ nuntakna sisan kimu hi. Hih thu pen a simthama thu kanna tawh ka muh hilo a, pasian-biakna na lunggulh luatna hanga hih nate khempeuh na sepna hangin a kimukhia ahi-zaw hi.
Tua hinapi-in nangmah in, ‘Ka mawhpeng hi! Kei tungah Ama hehna kiheikhia khin hi!’ na ci lai hi. En in, nangmah in, ‘Ka mawh kei hi!’ ci na hih manin nang tungah thu kong khen ding hi.
Bang hangin na lungsim khel ziauziau na hi hiam? Assyria in nang hong maizumsak ngei bangin Egypt in nang hong maizumsak ding hi.
Hi hi, Yahweh in na kimuanna khempeuh nolh khin a, amaute in nang hong huh lo ding uh ahih manin na lu tungah na khut guak bek nga-in tua mun na nusia ding hi.

Amaute in, “Pasal khat in a zi ma-in, tuanu in amah nusia a, pasal dang khat’ zi suak leh, a pasal masa in tuanu la kik ding ahi hiam? Tua gam teng nakpi-in a ninsakkhin hilo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi. Ahih hangin nang pen lawm ngaih tampi tawh na paktat a, tua hinapi-in Kei kiangah nong ciah kik hi, Yahweh in ci hi!

Mual sang dawnte lam ah khuadak to dih in, na kilupkhoppih lohna mun koi-ah om hiam en dih in. Sehnel gam-a Arab mite bangin lam kiangah na luppih dingte ngakin na tu hi; Na paktatna leh na gitlohna tawh hih gam na ninsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin guahtui kikang sak a, guah nunung hong pai lo hi. Tua hinapi-in na paktat mit-hah lai-a, na zum tuan kei hi.
Tu-a kipanin Kei kiangah, ‘Ka Pa aw, ka nau lai-a kipan lam hong lakpa na hi,’ hong ci lo ding na hi hiam?
Amah in a tawntungin heh suak ding ahi hiam? A tawp dongin a hehna zom suak ding ahi hiam? En in, tua bangin na pau a, ahih hangin na hih theih zahin hih thusiate khempeuh na bawl hi.
Kumpi Yoshiyah uk hun sung Yahweh in kei hong hopih a, “A nungtolh Israyl-te gamtatna na mu hiam? Amah mual sang tung teng leh singliim nuai tengah pai to-in, tua lai-ah a paktat hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, ‘Hih teng khempeuh ahih khit ciangin kei kiangah hong kiheikik ngawn ding hi!’ ka cih hangin amah hong kihei tuan lo hi. Tua ciangin a gina lo a sanggamnu ahi Yahdah in zong a mu hi.

A citak lo Israyl, mi dang; pasiante biakna, tawh a mawhna hang mahmah-in Keimah, Yahweh in hawlkhia-in makna lai ka piakna zong Yahdah in thei pipi mah-in, a gina lo a sanggamnu ahi Yahdah zong lau tuan lo lai a, amah pai-in, a paktat; pasiante nung a zui, veve hi.
Hih pen ama mawhna thu neu ngaihsut-in, amah in leitang ninsak a, a siangtho khuamte leh sing pasiante (elohim, teraphim) tawh a mawhna hang ahi hi.
Hih bang teng hinapi-in, a gina lo a sanggamnu ahi Yahdah zong a lungsim khempeuh tawh Kei lamah hong kihei tuan lo a, kineih khemna bek tawh hong kihei hi! Yahweh in kong ci hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in keima tungah, “A nungtolh Israyl, a gina lo Yahdah sangin amahmah kithutang sakzaw hi.

Pai inla, leilu lamah hih thute va tangko inla, ‘A nungtolh Israyl aw, hong ciahkik in, Yahweh in ci a, nangma tungah Ka hehna kong tusak kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hehpihna ka nei hi, Yahweh in ci hi: a tawntungin ka heh paisuak kei ding hi.

Yahweh na Pa tungah na thupalsatna, singliim nuai-a gamdangte; pasiante, lakah na itna teng na thehthangna leh Ka thu nong man lohnate ahi nangma mawhnate hong pulak in, Yahweh in ci hi,’ ci-in gen in” hong ci hi.

A nungtolh tate aw, kileh kik un, Yahweh in kong ci hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in note kong tenpih hi. Keimah in khuapi khat panin khat, innkuan khat panin nih kong la ding a, Zion ah note kong paipih ding hi.
Tua ciangin pilna leh thutheihna tawh note hong vaak dingin ka lungsim tawh a kituak tuucing hoih note kong pia ding hi.

Tua ni ciangin hih bangin hong piang ding hi: Yahweh in ci hi, note pungin tampi na phak uh ciangin, amaute in, “Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang!” ci-in genin a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. A lungsim sung uh ah lut loin, zong phawk se loin, goih se lo ding uh a, a dang khat zong kibawl kik nawn lo ding hi.

Tua hun ciangin Yerusalem khua pen Yahweh’ Kumpi-tokhom kici ding a, minam khempeuh tua lai-ah, Yahweh’ Min ah, Yerusalem ah hong kikaikhawm ding uh hi. A sia amau lungsim tawh a ngaihsut tawmnate, amaute in zuih-in a nei nawn kei ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin Yahdah’ innkuan pen Israyl’ innkuan tawh tonkhawm ding a, leilu lam gam panin amaute hong paikhia khawm-in a pu a pate tungah gamh-in ka piaksa leitang ah hong pai ding uh hi.

Keimah in, ‘Tate lakah nang hong koih-in, gam nuam, minam honpite gamh hoih khat bangci bangin hong pia ding ka hi hiam?’ kong ci hi. ‘Nangmah in, ‘Ka Pa aw,’ ci-in hong samin, Kei kiang panin na kihei kei ding hi,’ kong ci hi.
Israyl’ innkuan aw, a citak lo zi a pasal a taisan bangin, Kei tungah nong citak kei hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Mun sangnate ah aw khat kiza a, Israyl mite kahna leh tauna aw ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute lampil-in, Yahweh a Pa taisan uh hi.
No a nungtolh tate aw, hong ciahkik un; tua ciangin na nungtolhna uh kong damsak ding hi. En in Nang pen Yahweh kote Pa na hih manin na kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Mual tungte leh mual lian tampite panin lametna pen a mawkna pi taktak hi a, Yahweh i Pa sung bek ah Israyl hotkhiatna om hi.
I neu lai-a kipan i pu i pate nasepna ahi a tuuhonte leh a bawnghonte, a tapate uh leh a tanute, Maizumna; Bosheth; Baal, in gaitum hi.
Maizumin i lum a, mindaina in eite hong tuam hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh i neu tunga kipanin tuni ciang dong eite leh i pu i pate in Yahweh tungah mawhna i bawl a, Yahweh i Pa’ thu i mang kei hi.
Israyl aw, a ciahkik ding na hih leh, Kei kiangah hong ciahkik in! Yahweh in ci hi. Na kihhuainate; pasiante, uh Ka muhna panin na paihkhiat uh a, na tai kawikawi kei uh leh,
Man tak, thutang tak leh thumaan takin, ‘Yahweh a nuntak mah bangin’ ci-in na kiciam uh leh, tua ciangin Ama sungah minamte hampha kisa ding uh a, Ama sungah amaute a minthan ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah leh Israyl mite tungah Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na lote uh kal unla, ling lakah vawh kei un.

No Yahdah mite leh Yerusalem-a tengte aw, Yahweh tungah no-le-no vun ki-at unla, na lungtang vun uh paikhia un; tua bang hi keileh, note gamtat siatna hangin meikuang bangin Ka hehna hong paikhia ding a, kuama phelh zawh lohin kuang kha ding hi.
Yahdah sungah gen unla, Yerusalem ah tangko un. Gam sungah peengkul mut un, ci un. Nakpi-in kiko unla, ‘Kikaikhawm-in, khuapi muanhuaite sungah lut ni!’ va ci un.
Zion lamah dialkhai unla, kibu un! Zekai kei un! Bang hang hiam cihleh leilu lam panin siatna ka puak ding a, suksiatna lian mahmah ding hi.

A bukna sawlkawm panin humpinelkai hong pusuak khin a, minamte a susiapa hong pai ta hi. Na gam uh a kisiasak dingin ama omna panin hong paikhia khin hi. Na khuapite uh kisia-in kuamah teng lo ding hi.
Hih thu hangin, puanhampi silh-in, tau-in kap un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ heh mahmahna eite tawh kipelh nai lo hi.
Tua ni ciangin hih bangin hong piang ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi: kumpipa leh uliante lungkia ding uh a, siampite lau mahmah-in, kamsangte a dip kua ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ah, Yahweh ka Pa! ‘Nopna na ngah ding uh hi,’ kici a, tu-in ka nawng uh ah namsau hong kinga ahih manin, hih mite leh Yerusalem tungah khemna lianpi a tun ding na phal khin takpi hi!

Tua hun ciangin hih mite tung leh Yerusalem tungah hih bangin kici ding hi: Sehnel gam mual sangte panin Ka mite lamah a sa mahmah huih nung a, ahih hangin an vaite zap nading leh siansak nading ahi kei hi;
Kei kiang panin a pai tua huih khauh lua mahmah hi. Tu-in amaute tungah ka thukhenna ka genkhia hi.
En un, meii bangin amah hong paito-in, a sakol leengte pingpei tawh kibang ding hi. A sakolte pen muvanlai sangin manlangzaw hi. Gimna thuak ta hang ei! A kisia hi ta hang ei!
Yerusalem aw, na suahtak nadingin na gitlohna lungtang sawpkhia in. Bang tanvei na kiphatsakna lungsim na sungah om ding ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh Dan panin aw khat ging khia a, Ephraim mual panin thuaksak nading thu kitangko hi.
Hih thu minamte tungah gen un; hi hi, gamlapi gam panin galte hong paina leh Yahdah khuapite langkhat ah galphuangin a kikona uh Yerusalem kiangah va tangko un.
Yahdah in Kei hong lehdo ahih manin lo hungte bangin amaute in umcih uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Na gamtatnate leh na sepnate hangin hihte nang tungah hong tung hi; hih in nangma gitlohna hang hi a, kha-in, na lungtang hong vut hi.
Lunggim sing! Lunggim sing! Ka lungtang na mahmah hi! Ka sungah ka lungtang kisai vanvan a, ka om hit-hiat thei kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka kha aw, gal patau tangkona peengkul aw na za khin hi.
Siatna khat khit khat tung a, gam sung buppi kisia hi. Thakhat thu-ini ka bukte kisia a, ka dalna puante kikek pah hi.
Bang tanvei lan khai mu-in, peengkul aw za lai ding ka hi hiam?
Ka mite hai mahmah-in Kei hong thei lo uh hi. Siatna bawl siam mahmah uh a, ahih hangin a hoih sep ding a theithei kei uh hi.
Leitung ka en a, lim leh meel nei loin a hawmpi hi a, vantungte in khuavak nei lo uh hi.
Mual liante ka en a, tuate liing damdam hi; mual neute khempeuh a kivei kawikawi hi.
Keimah in ka en a, mi khat beek a om kei hi; huih lak vasate khempeuh a lengmang khin hi.
Keimah in ka en a, tua gam hoih pen gamlak suak a, Yahweh mai-ah a heh mahmahna in a khuapite khempeuh suzan hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Gambup kisia ding a, ahih hangin ka susia kiuhkeuh sam kei ding hi.
Hih hangin leitung kap ding a, tunga vantungte mial ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka gensa, ka ciamsa hi a, ka khiam kei ding a, zong ka dokkik kei ding hi.

Sakol tuangte leh thal tawite gamlumna hangin khuapi bup taikek ding hi. Amaute in sawlkawm sung phulin, suang tungah kahto ding uh hi. Khuapi khempeuh kinusia ding a, tua khuapite ah mi khat beek zong teng lo ding hi.

Na na kisiat ciangin, bang hih ding na hi hiam? Puan ausan silh a, kham kizepnate tawh kizemin, na mitte na zep hangin a mawkna-in a kizem na hi ding hi; na lawmngaihte in nang hong nusia ding a, amaute in na nuntakna thah dingin hong zong ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh numei nausuak bang kikona, tacil a suak numei khat banga tauna, a khutte zankhia-in husam liangin Zion’ tanu in, “Tu-in dah mah sing; mi thatte hangin ka kha zawmta hi!” ci-in a kikona ka za hi.

Yerusalem kongzing ah tai kawikawi un; tu-in mu unla thei un. Mi khat peuh na muh hiam tual awng tengah va zong un; thu man kanin, thutang takin a gamta khat beek a om leh, tua khua a mawhna ka maisak ding hi.
Amaute in, “Yahweh a nuntak mah bangin!” ci-in a kiciam uh hangin, zuaupi-a kiciam uh ahi hi.

Yahweh aw, na mitte in thu man en hilo ahi hiham? Nangmah in amaute na sat hangin amaute dah tuan lo uh hi. Amaute na sukgawp hangin, puahphatna a sang nuam tuan kei uh hi. Amaute in a maitang uh suangtum sangin khauhsakzaw uh a, a kilehkik nuam kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in, “Hih mite hai taktak uh a, a hehpih huai ahi uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ lampi thei lo uh a, a Pa uh thutanna zong a thei kei uh hi.

Mi liante kiangah keimah pai-in ka va kiho ding hi; bang hnag hiam cihleh amaute in Yahweh’ lampi leh a Pa uh thutanna thei uh hi. Ahih hangin hihte in hakkol sutan khin uh a, kihenna khau teng a sutat khin uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin gamlak humpinelkai in amaute thatlum-in, sehnelgam keivom in amaute susia ding a, gialbem khat in a khuapite uh pang gige ding hi. Tua lai panin a paikhia peuhpeuh kibalnen ding hi; ahang in amau thupalsatnate tamin, amau nungtolhna khang semsem hi.

Bang hangin na mawhna uh hong maisak ding ka hi hiam? Na tate in Kei hong taisan khin uh a, vangliatna a nei lo pasiante tawh kiciam uh hi! Amaute a gilvah dongin ka vak khit ciangin, amaute pasiante tawh paktat uh a, numei paktatte’ inn; pasian kibiakna innte, ah a honin tuahkhawm uh hi.

Hih thute hangin amaute dan pia lo ding ka hi hiam? Hici bang minam tungah tungah thuk lo ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
A kulhte tungah pai inla, susia in; ahih hangin a vekpi-in susia khin kei in. A hiangte satkhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen Yahweh aa hi lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ innkuan leh Yahdah’ innkuan pen Kei tungah gina lo takin hong gamta uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ thu ah zuau phuak uh a, ‘Amah in bangmah hih lo ding hi! Ei tungah siatna hong tung lo ding a, namsau ahi a, kialpi ahi zong i mukha kei ding hi,’ ci uh hi.
Kamsangte lah huih bang uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute sungah Yahweh’ thu om lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau gen bangn amau tungah kibawl ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En un, no kamsang zuaute in hih thu na gen na hih manun, Ka thute na kamsung uh ah meikuang ka suaksak ding a, hih mite singkhuah suaksakin, tua in amaute kangtum ding hi.

Israyl’ innkuan aw, en in, nang lang a pang dingin gamlapi panin minam khat kong paipih ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi. Tua pen tangtawng-a omsa, note in amau pau thei loin, amau thugen na tel zawh loh uh minam thahat khat ahi hi.
Amaute thaltang bawm pen hankhuk kihongsa tawh kibang a, amaute khempeuh a thahat galhangte ahi uh hi.

Amaute in na an lak dingte leh na ante uh gai tum ding a, amaute in na tapate leh na tanute hong gaihtumsak ding uh hi; amaute in na tuuhonte leh na ganhonte ne tum ding uh hi; amaute in na leengguite leh na theikungte gai tum ding hi; note in na muan uh kulh-a ki-um na khuapite uh zawngtum sak ding a, namsau tawh tuate a susia ding uh hi.
Tua hinapi-in tua nite ciangin note khempeuh kong beisiangsak kei ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Hih bangin hong piang ding hi: na mipihte in, ‘Bang hangin i Pa Yahweh in hihte khempeuh hih ahi hiam?’ na cih uh ciangin nangmah in, ‘Note in Yahweh nusia-in, na gam sung uh ah gamdangte’ pasiante’ na nasep bang tektekun, note gam ahi lo gam dang ah gamdang mite’ na na sem ding uh hi,’ ci-in dawng in.
Yaaqob’ innkuan ah hih thu gen inla, Yahdah sungah tangko in:
Mit nei napi-in mu thei loin, bil nei napi-in a za thei lo, thu tel thei lo mihaite aw, hih thu za un!

Kei hong zahtak lo ding na hi uh hiam? Yahweh in kong ci hi. Tuipi in a khen loh dingin gamgi bangin tawntung thukip tawh sehnel a koihpa Keima mai-ah liing lo ding na hi uh hiam? Tua hi a, tuihualte in tua sehnal suknawt tonawt napi-in zo zolo uh a, a gin zuazua uh hangin a kantan zo tuan kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin hih mite lungkhauh-in, lehdo nopna lungsim nei uh hi; Kei kiang panin amaute lampial khin uh a, kihei mang khin uh hi.
Amaute in a lungsim sung uh ah, ‘A hunhunin guah zusakin, tukguah khal guah hong pia a, eite aa dingin anlak hun hong sehsak Yahweh i Pa tu-in zahtak ni,’ a ci kei uh hi.
Na khialhnate un hih thuphate heikhia mang a, na mawhnate un no kiangah thupha hoihte a khak tan hi.
Ka mite lakah migilote kimu a, thang a zak mi khat bangin pang khinkhian uh a, amaute in thangsiah-in mi a man uh hi.
Bawm sung dima vasa kikhum bangin, amau inn sungah zuauthu dim hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute lianin hau uh hi.
Amaute thau-in zol uh hi. Hi hi, amaute in gitloh gamtatna ah val semsem uh hi. Amaute in pa nei lote thu a zawh nadingin thukhen lo uh a, mizawngte thu a langpan uh hi.
Hih thute hangin dantah lo ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi. Hih banga gamta minam tungah thuk lo ding ka hi hiam?
Gam sungah a dipkuat huai-in a patauh huai thu khat kigamta hi:
Kamsangte in zuau thu gen-in, siampite in amau utthu-in uk uh a, Ka mite in tua thu a deih lai uh hi. Ahih hangin a tawpna hong tun ciangin bang na cih ding uh hiam?

No Benyamin’ suante aw, Yerusalem laizang panin taikhia dingin kikaikhawm un! Tekoa ah peengkul muut unla, Beth ha-Cherem; Suksiat Maimangna Inn, ah theisakna meikuang lan khai un; bang hang hiam cihleh leilu lam panin siatna, nakpi takin suksiatna hong kilangkhia hi.
Keimah in Zion’ tanu pen it-huai-in a ngek dikdek numei tawh ka tehkak khin hi.
Tuucingte a tuuhon uh tawh ama kiangah pai ding uh hi. A kiimkot, Zion kiangah a puanbukte lam ding uh hi. Amaute in amau mun ciat ah a tuute a khah ding uh hi.
‘Zion do dingin kithawi un! Tho un, sun ciangin i sim ding hi. Citciat aw, sun hun bei ta a, nitak liimte sau ta hi.
Ding un, zanin pai ni; a kumpi-innte susia ni,’ a ci ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Singkungte phuk unla, Yerusalem sim nadingin phungin ciang un. Hih pen a kidantah hamtang ding khuapi hi; tua lai-ah kinetniamna sim loh bangmah om lo hi.
Tuikhuk panin tui a phulkhiat bangin amah sung panin gitlohna phulkhia hi. Ngongtatna leh vankisuhna ama sungah kiza hi. Ka mai-ah dahna leh liamna om ngitnget hi.
Yerusalem aw, kidawm in! Tua bang na hih keileh kong kiheisan ding a, kuama ten loh dingin na gam ka kisiasak ding hi.
Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Amaute in Israyl a omlaisunte leenggah a sangh kaikhoppa in a khut zam-in, a hiangte kai-in a lak bangin la siang ding uh hi!

A zak theih nadingun kua kiangah genin, vauhilh ding ka hi hiam? En in, a bil uh vun ki-at lo a, amaute in za thei lo uh hi. En in, Yahweh’ thu pen amaute aa dingin zakdahhuai a, tua thu ah nuam a sa kei uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ heh mahmahna tawh ka kidim a, ka sungah ka ip zo nawn kei hi. Yahweh in ci hi: Kong zing laka naupangte tung leh a kithuah khawm tangvalte tungah ka hehna ka sung ding a, papite nangawn a zite tawh kila khawmin, khanghamte zong a tek mahmahte tawh kila khawm ding hi.
Amau innte, a lote leh a zite uh midang aa suak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua gam sunga tengte langah Ka khut ka vankhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a neupen panin a lianpen dongin a vekpi-un met nading ah huaiham lua uh hi. Kamsangte-a kipan siampite dongin zuau gamtat uh hi.
Amaute in Ka mite’ thuaknate thupi simsak lo uh a, kilemna om lo pipi, “Kilemna om! Kilemna om!” a ci uh hi.

Kihhuaina a gamtat uh ciangin amaute a maizum uh hiam? Maizum peuhmah lo uh a, zong a kisuang kei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin a puk mite lalkah puk ding uh hi. Amaute tungah dantahna ka tunsak hun ciangin, amaute kilawnkhia ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Lamkabom ah ding unla, khuadak un. Lam hoih ahi lam luite dong unla tawn un. No aa dingin tawldamna na mu ding uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in, ‘Tua lai ka tawn kei ding uh hi!’ a ci uh hi.
Tua banah, note hong vil ding mi ka koih hi. Peengkul aw thudon un! Ahih hangin amaute in, ‘Ka thudon kei ding uh hi!’ a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin no minamte aw, za un; amaute laka om no mihonte aw, thei un.
Leitung aw, za in! En in, amau ngaihsutna gah mah ahi siatna hih mite tungah ka tungsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ka kammalte thudon lo uh a, Ka Thukham a nial uh hi.

Sheba pana paknamtui gim ahi a, a gamla gam pana sing namtui gim ahi zongin bang awlmawh ding ka hi hiam? Note meihal biaknate hitaleh Keima tunga gim namtui note nong biakpiaknate uh hitaleh san theih hilo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, hih mite mai-ah a palkhak ding suang ka koih ding a, tuate hangin pate leh tate puk khawm ding a, vengpa leh a lawm sikhawm ding hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, leilu lam panin minam khat hong pai a, lei mongpen panin minam lian khat kithawithawi ta hi.

Amaute in thal leh teipi tawi ding uh hi; Amaute gamh-in hehpihna a nei kei uh hi. Amau awte tuipi bangin hawk a, sakol tungah a tuang uh hi. Zion’ tanu aw, nang hong sim dingin galdote bangin kigualin hong pai uh hi.
Tua thu i za khin zo a, bangmah i cih thei kei hi. Lungkhamna in hong lencip a, nupi nau suak ding bangin na i sa hi.
Gamlak ah paikhia kei unla, lampi ah zong pai dah un; bang hang hiam cihleh galte’ namsau leh lauhuaina pen i kiimkot khempeuh ah om hi.
Ka mite’ tanu aw, puanhampi silh inla, vut lakah kikhuk in! Tapa khat neih sun sihsuah bangin nakpi takin kapin tau in; bang hang hiam cihleh susiate pen eite kiangah thakhatin hong tung ding hi.
Sik sittelna-in nang kong bawl a, Ka mite siktuangin ka bawl hi; tua ahih ciangin amau lampite kan inla, sittel in.
Amaute khempeuh a langpan tentante hi uh a, mi gensia-in vak kawikawi uh hi. Amaute pen nangma sittel sumngo leh sikte ahi uh hi. Amaute khempeuh a siat gamtatte ahi uh hi.
Mei tawh a hakte a tuikhia dingin nakpi takin a zap hangin siansak sawmna a mawkna pi hi a, gitlohna pen paikhia lo hi.
Amaute pen a kideih lo ngun kici hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute a deih kei hi.
Hih in Yeremyah tunga a tung Yahweh kiang pana thu ahi hi:
Yahweh’ Inn kulh kongpi ah ding inla, tua lai-ah hih thu tangko in: Yahweh bia dingin hih kulh kongpite sunga a lut no Yahdah-te khempeuh aw, Yahweh kammal za un!
Israyl’ Pa, Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na nuntakzia leh na gamtatnate uh kipuahpha un; tua hileh hih mun ah note tawh hong kong khawm ding hi.
‘Hih in Yahweh’ mun siangtho hi! Yahweh’ munsiangtho! Yahweh’ mun siangtho!’ ci-a a gen uh hih zuauthute muan-in nei kei un.
Na nuntakziate leh na gamtatnate uh na kikhel taktak kei uh a, mi khat leh a vengpa kikhal thu ah thutang takin thu na khen kei uh leh,
nam dangte, pa nei lote leh meigongte nengniam loin, hih mun ah mawhbaang lo sisan na luansak kei uh a, nomauh mah in na thuak loh nadingun a kikham pasiante na zuih kei uh leh,
na pu na pate uh tungah a tawntungin ka piaksa hih gam sung, hih mun ah ka teng ding hi.
Ahih hangin en un, note in kimanna nei lo zuau thute na muang uh hi!
Note guta-in, mi that-in, nu leh pa mawhna bawl-in, a man loin kiciamin, Baal tungah paknamtui halin, a thu na theih loh uh a kikham pasiante zui-in,
tua khit ciangin hong pai-in Ka Min tawh a kilo hih Inn sung Keima mai-ah hong dingin, ‘Eite i suakta hi!’ ci-in hih a kihhuai nate khempeuh hih kik ding na hi uh hiam?
Ka Min tawh a kilo hih Inn, note muhna ah gutate bukna suaksak khin na hi uh hiam? En un, Keimah, Kei mahmah in hih thu ka mu khin hi! Yahweh in ci hi.
Ahih hangin Keimah in Ka Min ka koih masakna mun Shiloh khua sunga Ka mun ah na ut uh leh va pai unla, Ka mi Israyl-te gitlohna hanga tua lai-a ka hihna va mu un.
Tua hi a, tu-in note in hihte khempeuh sem khin na hih manun, Yahweh in ci hi: thobai-in kong gen a, ahih hangin na za kei uh hi; note kong sam a, ahih hangin nong dawng kei uh hi;
tua ahih ciangin Ka Min tawh a kilo hih Inn—note in muanin na neih uh mun, note leh note mai-a na pu na pate aa dingin ka piak mun— Shiloh tunga ka bawlsa bang tektekin ka bawl ding hi.
Keimah in na sanggamte khempeuh: Ephraim suanlekhak buppi, ka paihkhiat bangin Ka muhna panin note kong paaikhia ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih mite aa dingin thungen kei inla, amau aa dingin kahna ahi a, thungetsakna ahi a, Kei tungah thuumsakna ahi zongin hih kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh nong thuumna kong dawng kei ding hi.
Amaute in Yahdah khuapite sung leh Yerusalem kongzing laka a gamtatna uh mu lo na hi hiam?

A tate un sing tomin, a pate un meicih a, nupite in Vantung Kumpinu aa dingin moh bawl nading annel a mekmanna leh a kikham pasiante tungah dawn-a biaknate a piakna uh tawh Keimah hong hehsakna mu lo na hi hiam?
Amaute hehsak Keimah hilo ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi: Ahih keileh amau maizum nadingin a thuaksak uh amau mah hilo ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna hih mun ah ka pua ding a, mihing tung leh ganhing tung, lo sunga singkungte tung leh leilaka singgahte tung ah ka bua ding a, kangin a kiphelh zo kei ding hi.
Israyl’ Pa, vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na meihal biaknate uh a dang na biakpiaknate tawh koih unla, a sate ne vet un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam panin na pu na pate ka paikhiatpih lai-in amaute tungah meihal biaknate ahi a, biakpiaknate ahi zongin ka gen kei a, thu zong ka pia kei hi;

Ahi zongin amaute tungah ka thupiak in hih ahi hi: Ka thu hong mang un; tua ciangin Kei pen note’ Pa ka hi ding a, note pen Ka mite na hi ding uh hi. Note na hoih nadingun note kong thupiaksa Ka lampite khempeuh zui un!
Ahih hangin amaute in thu mang lo uh a, zong hong thudon kei uh hi. Tua bang gen lohin amau lungsim sia ngaihsutna leh amau thuthu-in gamta zawsop uh a, mainawt loin a nungkik uh hi.
Na pu na pate uh Egypt gam pan a paikhiat ni a kipan tuni ciang mahmah dong, nisim-in zingsang tuung mahin tho-in, Ka nasemte ahi kamsangte khempeuh note kiangah kong sawl hi.
Tua hinapi-in amautei n Ka thu hong mang lo uh a, zong hong thudon lo uh hi; tua bang gen loh, amaute lungkhauh zawsop-in, a pu a pate uh sangin suksiazaw lai uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in hih thute khempeuh amaute tungah na gen ding a, ahih hangin amaute in na thu hong mang lo ding uh hi. Nangmah in amaute na sam ding a, ahih hangin hong dawng lo ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute kiangah, “Hihte pen Yahweh a Pa uh thu mang loin, a puahphatna a sang nuam lo minam ahi hi. Thu man mangthang khin a, a kam panun zong a gen nawn kei uh hi,” na ci ding hi.
Yerusalem aw, na sat metkhia inla, paai in; mual sangah paito-in kap in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a hehhehna hih khang mite nial-in nusia khin hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah mite in ka muhna ah siatna bawl uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi: Amaute in a ninsak dingin Ka Min tawh a kilo Inn sungah amau kihhuainate koih uh hi.

Amaute in Molech aa dingin mei sungah a tapate a tanute a hal nadingin Ben-Hinnom Kuam sunga om Tophet munsang khat lam uh hi—tua pen sep dingin cikmah-a thu ka piak ngei loh, tua bang thu zong Ka lungsim-a om lo thu ahi hi!

Tua ahih ciangin en un, a hun hong tungta hi, Yahweh in ci hi: Tua mun pen Tophet ahi a, Ben-Hinnom Kuang ahi zongin a kicih nawn loh hun hong tung ding a, Thahna Kuam kici ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mun awng nawn lo zah dongin Tophet ah amaute kivui ding hi.
Hih mite luanghawm pen van-a vasate leh leitunga gamsate aa dingin an hi ding a, kuamah in amaute hawlkhia lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahdah khuapite pan leh Yerusalem kongzingte lak panin lungnopna leh kipakna aw, mopa leh monu aw ka beisak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua gam kinusia ding hi.
Yahweh in kong cih inah: Tua hun ciangin amaute in Yahdah kumpite’ guhte, a uliante uh guhte, siampite guhte, kamsangte guhte, Yerusalem-a tengte guhte, a hun sung uh panin lakhia ding hi.

Amaute in itin, a na a sepsak uh, a nungzuih uh, a zon uh leh a biak uh ahi ni, kha leh vantung-a a hon khempeuh mai-ah kiphokhia ding hi. Tuate zong kikhawm loin zong kiphum lo ding a, amaute pen leitung maitang ah ki-eknawtsiat ding hi.
Ka hawkhiatna mun-a a omlai, hih a gilo innkuan laka a omlaisunte in nuntakna sangin sihna lunggulhzaw ding uh hi, vanglian Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in nangmah in amaute kiangah va gen in: Mite a puk ciangin thokik lo ahi uh hiam? Mite lam a pial ciangin kilehkik hilo ahi uh hiam?
Tua hinapi-in bang hangin hih mite nungtolh-in nungkin paisuak lawmlawm ahi uh hiam? Amaute in zuau thu mah lenkip tentan-in, a kileh kik nuam kei uh hi.

Keimah in ngai-in ka za hi; ahih hangin amaute in thu man gen lo uh a, a gitlohna uh panin kuamah kisik loin, “Bang maw ka hih?” ci lel uh a, gal sunga sakol taigawp bangin amau tupna ciat a zui uh hi.
Van-a tui vapite nangawn in a lal hun ding thei uh hi. Vakhu, phialphiah leh gun vapite in zong a pai hun ding uh thei a, ahih hangin Ka mite in Ka ngeina kip a thei kei hi.
Bangci bangin note in, “Kote ka pil uh a, Yahweh’ Thukham ko tawh om hi,” ci thei ding na hi uh hiam? En un, laitheite laikung zuau in tuate khialsak a, a man loin a gelh hi.
Mipilte maizum uh hi; amaute mai mial-in, a kiman hi. En un, amaute in Yahweh’ thu nial khin uh ahih manin amau sungah bang pilna om ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin a zite uh midangte tungah ka pia ding a, a lote uh zong midangte ka luahsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a neupen panin a lianpen dongin a vekpi-un met nading ah huaiham lua uh hi. Kamsangte-a kipan siampite dongin zuau gamtat uh hi.
Amaute in Ka mite’ thuaknate thupi simsak lo uh a, kilemna om lo pipi, “Kilemna om! Kilemna om!” ci uh hi.

Kihhuaina a gamtat uh ciangin amaute a maizum uh hiam? Maizum peuhmah lo uh a, zong a kisuang kei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin a puk mite lalkah puk ding uh a, amaute tungah dantahna ka tunsak hun ciangin, amaute kilawnkhia ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Amaute ka susia khin ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi: Leenggui tungah leenggah ahi a, theikung tungah theigah ahi zongin om lo ding a, singtehte vul mang ding hi; amaute tungah ka piaksa nate amau kiang panin ka lakhia ding hi.

Bang hangin tutu i hi hiam? Kikaikhawm un! Khuapi muanhuai ah tai-in tua lai-ah va si ni; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh tungah eite mawh khin i hih manin Yahweh i Pa in a si dingin eite hong koih khin a, i dawn dingin gutui hong pia khin hi.
Eite in kilemna i lamen a, ahih hangin kilemna hong pai lo hi; cidamna hun i lamen a, ahih hangin gimna a om hi!

Dan panin galte’ sakol nakging kiza a, a sakol hatte hamna awging hangin gambup liinglawng hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute hong paikhin a, tua gam leh a sunga om khempeuh, khuapi leh a sunga tengte khempeuh susiamang hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh en un, Keimah in note lakah guipite ka sawl ding a, a kikhim thei lo gul gu neite khah-in, note hong tu ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Ka dahna ciangin kei le kei ka kihehnem a, ka sungah ka lungsim na mahmah hi.

Ngai un! Awging, a gamla gam panin ka mite’ tanu kikona; “Zion ah Yahweh om nawn lo ahi hiam? A Kumpipa om nawn lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Bang hangin a milim bawl tawmte uh leh a gamdang milimte tawh Kei hong hehsak ahi uh hiam?
Anlak hun khengin, khuakhal hun zong bei ta a, eite lah hong kihon kei hi!
Ka mite’ tanu liamna hangin kei zong a liam mah ka hi hi. Ka thuum a, lungkhamna in hong mancip hi.
Gilead ah zatui om lo ahi hiam? Tua lai-ah zato siam omlo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in bang hangin ka mite’ tanu cidamna dingin damkikna om thei lo ahi hiam?
Aw, ka lu tuikhuk hi-in ka mitte khitui nak hi leh aw, ka mite a kithahna hangin sun leh zanin kapkap ka kapkap ding hi!

Ka mite khempeuh angkawm hatin a thukip lo mi vive omkhawm ahih manin amaute nusia-in amau kiang panin ka paikhiat theih nadingin sehnelgam ah khualzin mite tun theihna bukno khat a nei hi leng ka ut hi!

Thal bangin amaute in a leii uh tawh zuauthu lawnkhia uh a, amaute a gam sungah a thahatna uh pen thu man tawh hilo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh siatna lam bek namawh tektek uh a, amaute in Kei hong thei lo uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

A kuamapeuh a vengpa kiang pan kidawm henla, a sanggam khatpeuh zong muang kei hen; bang hang hiam cihleh sanggam khatpeuh pen zuaukhemin a lungsim kawi khat na hi thei a, lawm khatpeuh zong a gensia hat khat na hi thei hi.
A kuamapeuh in a vengte khem a, thu man gen lo ding hi; amaute in a leii uh zuau gen dingin hilh a, mawhna bawlbawlin amau le amau a kigimsak uh hi.
Na tenna pen khemna lakah ahi hi; khemna hangin amaute in Kei hong thei nuam lo uh hi, Yahweh in hong ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, Keimah in amaute ka siangsak ding a, ka ze-et ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua bang loin Ka mite aa dingin bang cih nawn ding ka hi hiam?
Amau leiite sih theihna thaltang hi a, zuau thu a gen hi. A vengpa tungah a kam tawh hoih takin a gen hangin, a lungsim sungah a pang gige hi.
Hih thu hangin amaute dantah lo ding ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi. Keimahmah in hih banga gamta minam thuk lo ding ka hi hiam?

Mual liante aa dingin kapin ka tauding a, gamlak-a tenna munte aa dingin ka tamlo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate kangtum a, kuamah pai nawn loin bawng ham zong kiza nawn lo ding hi. Van-a vasate leh gam sate taimang-in, a om nawn kei hi!
Tua ciangin Yerusalem pen nin bulom kiciang ka bangsak ding gam-uite kua ka suaksak ding hi; Yahdah khuapite gamlak suaksakin kuamah a teng nawn kei ding hi.

Hih thu a telthei ding mipil kua ahi hiam? Hih thu a gen khia dingin Yahweh’ kam in a hopih kua ahi hiam? Kuamah in tua gam a nawk loh nadingin bang hangin tua gam kisia-in sehnel gam bangin kangtum ahi hiam?
Yahweh in ci hi: Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in amau mai-a ka koih Ka Thukham nusia-in, Ka thu hong mang lo uh a, thukham tawh kituakin kalsuan lo uh a,
tua gen lohin amau lungsim ngaihsut tawmna zui-in, a pu a pate uh hilhsa Baal-te zuih-in a neihna hang ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vanglian Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: En in, hih mite gamsai tawh ka vak ding a, gutui ka dawnsak ding hi.
Amaute ahi a, a pu a pate un ahi zongin a theih ngei loh uh minamte lakah amaute ka thehthang lai ding hi. Amaute ka siatsak khit matengin amaute nung ah namsau ka sawl ding hi.
Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ngaihsun unla, numei kapte hong pai nadingin va sam un; a kah siam tata hong pai nadingin vaikhak un.
Va kinawhsak unla, i mit panin i khituite a luan theih nading leh i mitkhute a kawt demdam nadingin eite hong kah uh hen.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Zion panin kahna aw kiza hi. Eite i kisia taktak hi! Nakpi takin i maizum hi; bang hang hiam cihleh eite in i gam nusiat kul ta a, i innte i taisan kul hi!
Numeite aw, Yahweh’ kammal za unla, na bil un Ama kam pana thute ngaisak un; na tanute uh kah dan hilh unla, na vengte ciat uh kah la hilh un;
Bang hang hiam cihleh tawlet vang panin sihna hong pai a, i kumpi-innte ah lut hi. Mun-awng tual-awng-a naupangte vat mang a, kongzing laka tangvalte vat lum hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Mite luanghawmte nangawn gamlak ah ek bangin kipaai ding a, kuama khop nawn loh buhlom ansa tawh a kibang ding hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Mipilte in a pilna uh kisaktheihpih kei uh henla, mi hatte in a hatna uh kisaktheihpih kei uh hen. Mi haute in zong a hauhna uh kisaktheihpih kei uh hen.

Ahih hangin hih thu ah kisa thei uh hen—Leitung ah itna kip, thumaanna leh thutanna zangin nasep nuam a sapa Keimah Yahweh ka hihna a hong theihna leh a hong telna uh kisaktheihpih hen, Yahweh in ci hi.
En un, Yahweh in kong cih inah: taksa vun-atna bek tawh vun a ki-at mite khempeuh ka dantah ni hun hong tung ding hi—

Egypt, Yahdah, Edom, Ammon mite, Moab leh sehnel gam-a teng a mongpen dong-a a omte khempeuh dantah ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih minamte khempeuh pen vun ki-at lo taktak uh a; Israyl innkuan khempeuh ahih leh lungsim vun ki-at lo hi.
Israyl’ innkuan aw, nang tawh kisai-in Yahweh hong gen kammal za un.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Minamte omzia sin kei unla, amaute pen vantunga lim lamdangte khemsa-in a om hangin note pen tuate khemsa-in om kei un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh minamte’ biakna ngeinate pen kimanna om lo hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh mi khat in gamlak panin singkung khat phuk a, khutsiampa khut in hei tawh a sui hi.
Amaute in ngun leh kham tawh zemin, a puk loh nadingin sek leh siktukilh tawh a khen hi.

Tuate pen nisuh kung bangin ding gimgem a, ahih hangin a pau thei kei hi; tuate puak kul hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau thu-in a pai thei kei uh hi. Amaute tungah zahtakna pia kei un! Amaute in siatna hong pia thei lo a, phatna zong a bawl thei kei hi.
Yahweh aw, nang tawh a kibang khat beek a om kei hi! Nang na lian a, Na Min vanglian-in thahat hi.

Minamte’ Kumpipa aw, kua in nang hong zahtak lo ding ahi hiam? Hi hi, zahtak ding mah na hi hi! Minamte mipilte khempeuh lakpan hitaleh amau kumpigam khempeuh pan hitaleh Nang tawh a kibang kuamah om lo hi!
Amaute khempeuh in theihtheih nei lo uh a, amau haina mah in ne tum hi; a mawknapi-a a hilhhilh uh thu in amau singtawng peuh ahi hi.

Khutsiamte leh kham sekte khut tawh a kibawl Tarshih panin ngun seksa leh Uphaz panin kham hong kipua hi. A dum leh a dupsan pen zep nadingin kizang hi; a vekpi-in biakpiakna-a zat dingin a bawl hi a, ahih hangin khutsiamte nasep ahi lel hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh pen Vanglianpa taktak ahi hi! Amah pen a nungta Pa leh tawntung Kumpipa ahi hi! Amah a heh ciangin leitung kiliing a, minamte in Ama thangpaihna nang zong lo ding uh hi.
Nangmah in amaute tungah na gen ding thu in hih ahi hi: Vantungte leh leitung a bawl lo hih pasiante hih vanpi nuai leh leitung panin mangthang ding uh hi!
Amah in a vangliatna tawh leitung bawl khin a, a pilna tawh leitung kipsak khin hi; Ama ngaihsut siamna tawh vantungte a zalkhia hi.
Amah in a aw a ginsak ciangin vantung ah tui tampi om a, Amah in lei mong panin tuikhute a kahto sak hi. Amah in khuaphia leh guah bawl a, a vankholna panin huih a nungkhia sak hi.

Mi khempeuh in ngaihsutna siamna nei loin thutheihna a nei kei uh hi; kham sekte khempeuh, a seksa milimte hangin maizum lawh uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a milim sunte uh zuau hi lel a, tuate sungah nuntakna om lo hi.
Amaute pen a mawknapi leh metdok nasepna ahi hi. Amau dantahna hun a tun ciangin amaute kisia ding uh hi.
Yaaqob’ Tanhtuampa pen amaute bang ahi kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah pen na khempeuh a Bawlpa hi a, Israyl pen Ama luah minam ahi hi. Ama Min in vanglian Yahweh ahi hi.
Galte umcih a thuak mite aw, hih gam nusia dingin na neihsa teng uh kaikhawm un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En un, hih gam sunga tengte vik khatin ka lawnkhia ding a, a theih nadingin amau tungah lungkhamna ka tungsak ding hi.
Ka suksiatna dahhuai hi! Ka vatna nasia mahmah hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in, “Hih gimna pen mi tungah ka tungsak taktak ding hi!” ka ci khin hi.

Ka biakbuk pen kisusia a, Ka khaute khempeuh kitat khin hi. Ka tate galmat bangin Kei kiang panin paikhia khin a, om nawn lo uh hi. Ka puanbuk a phut ding leh Ka kongkhak puante hong khaisak ding kuamah om lo hi.
Tuucingte in ngaihsutna nei loin, Yahweh a zon lohna uh hangin hih bangin a piang ding ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute maa pai lo ding uh a, a tuute khempeuh kithehthang ding hi.
En un, Yahdah khuapite a siasak ding leh gam-ui kua a suaksak dingin leilu-lam gam panin a lian mahmah husa leh thupuakte gamlumna hong tung khin hi.
Yahweh aw, mihing’ zia pen amahmah in a uk theih ahih loh lam ka thei hi. Ama kalsuan nading ama geel theih hilo hi.
Yahweh aw, hehna tawh hi loin thutanna tawh kei hong puahpha in; heh lecin bangmah lo ka suak ding hi.

Nang hong thei lo minamte tungah na thangpaihna sungkhia in! Na Min tawh hong sam lo mite tungah na hehna sung in! Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Yaaqob ne-in valh-in, gaitum uh a, a tenna mun a siasak khin uh hi.
Yeremyah tunga tung Yahweh kiang pana thu inah:
Hih thuciamna Thukhamte ngai inla, Yahdah mite leh Yerusalem-a tengte hopih-in,
amaute tungah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih thuciamna Thukhamte a mang lo mi pen samsiat ahi hi—

Sik hal tuina, Egypt gam panin na pu na pate ka paikhiatpih lai-in amaute tungah ka thupiak hi a, amaute tungah, ‘Ka thu mang un; kong thupiak bangin limtakin sem un; tua hileh Ka mite na hi ding uh a, Kei pen note Pa kong hi ding hi,’ ka ci hi;

tua bang na hih uh leh na pu na pate uh tunga ka ciamsa, tu-a na neih uh bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna gam kong pia ding hi, ci-in thu ka pia hi,” ci-in gen in. Tua ciangin keimah in ka dawng a, “Tua bang hi tahen, Yahweh aw,” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kiangah, “Yahdah khuapite leh Yerusalem kongzing lakah hih Thukhamte khempeuh tangko inla, ‘Hih thuciamna Thukhamte ngai unla, tua bangin gamta un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam panin na pu na pate ka paikhiatpih ni-a kipan tuni mahmah dong Ka thu hong mang un, ci-in limtakin ka vauhilh ngitnget hi.

Tua hinapi-in amaute in ka thu hong mang lo uh a, kin-in zong na nei kei uh hi; tua ban ah a vekpi-un a sia amau lungsim ngaihsut tawmna mah a zui uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute tungah ka hih ding hi, ci-a ka gensa thuciamna sunga samsiatnate khempeuh amaute tungah ka tungsak ding hi, ka ci hi—Ahih hangin amaute in Ka thuciamna zui tuan lo uh hi,’ ci in,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kiangah, “Yahdah mite lak leh Yerusalem-a tengte lakah sawmsimna a om hi.

Ka Thukhamte a mang nuam lo a pu pate uh mawhna lamah amaute kihei kik uh a, a kikham pasiante’ na sem dingin a zui khin uh hi! Israyl’ innkuan leh Yahdah innkuan in a pu a pate tawh ka bawl Ka thuciamna palsat khin tuak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in kong cih inah: En in, a suahtak theih loh ding gimna amau tungah ka tungsak ding a, Kei tungah amaute hong kiko uh hangin, ka dawng kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahdah khuapite leh Yerusalem-a tengte pai-in, paknamtui a piak uh pasiante tungah kiko ding uh a, ahih hangin amau haksat hun ciangin tuate in a hon peuhmah kei ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah aw, na khuapi om zahzah pasian na nei a, Yerusalem kongzing om zahzah Bosheth; Maizumna, ah biaknataute na dawh hi—tuate pen Baal tunga paknamtui hal nading biaknataute ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih mite aa dingin thungetsak kei inla, amau aa dingin thuumsakna ahi a, thungetna ahi zongin bawl kei in. Bang hang hiam cihleh amau buai-na hangin Kei tungah hong kiko hun ciangin amaute ka dawng kei ding hi.

Ka itte in tampi tawh a mawh khit ciangin Ka Inn sungah bang thu nei nawn ding ahi hiam? A siangtho biakpiakna sate in no kiang panin siatna heikhia thei ding ahi hiam? Hihte hanga hong tung ding siatna panin suakta-in lungdam kipak thei ding na hi hiam?
Gah hoih gah-in a deih huai Olive Kung Hing, ci-in Yahweh in na min hong phuah hi. Ahih hangin a ging zuazua-in Amah in mei tawh hal khin a, a hiangte a kitan hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ innkuan leh Yahdah’ innkuan’ siatna hangin note hong suan vanglian Yahweh in note tungah dantahna hong tungsak hi; tua pen baal tungah paknamtui biakna piakna tawh Kei hong hehsakna hangin amau mah a kisuat tawm siatna ahi hi,” hong ci hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in tua thu kei hong theisak a, ka thei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in amau gamtatnate nong lak hi.

Ahih hangin a kigo dingin a kipaipih hiat-hiat tuuno tawh ka kibang hi. Amaute in kei langah hong sawmsimna uh ka thei kha kei a, “A kung leh a gah susia khawm ni; ama min a kiphawk nawn loh nadingin a nungtate gam panin amah satkhia ni,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin thumaan taka thu a khen, lungsim leh ngaihsutna a sittel, vanglian Yahweh aw, nang tungah ka thu kong ap khin ka hih manin amaute tungah na thukkikna hong musak in.
Tua ahih ciangin hong that nuamin, “Yahweh’ Min tawh kamsang kei in; tua bang hi keileh komau khut tawh na si ding hi!” a ci Anathoth mite tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vanglian Yahweh hih bangin ci hi: En un, amaute ka dantat ding hi. Tangvalte namsau tawh ki ding a, a tate leh a tanute kialpi tawh si ding hi.
Amaute khat zong suakta lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute dan ka puak kumin Anathoth mite tungah siatna ka tungsak ding hi.

Yahweh aw, nang na thumaan a, kong nial zo kei ding hi. Tua hinapi-in Na thukhennate tawh kisai nang tawh kong kuppih nuam lai hi. Bang hangin migilote daupai uh ahi hiam? Bang hangin mi khem hatte khempeuh nuntak nuam uh ahi hiam?
Nangmah in amaute na suan a, amaute zungkha takpi mah-in a khang uh hi; amaute a gah takpi mah uh hi. A kam uh tawh nang hong nai napi, a lungsim uh tawh na kigamla hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, kei nong thei hi. Kei nong mutel khin a, Nang tawh kisai-in ka lungsim na sittel khin hi. Gawh ding tuute bangin amaute kaikhia inla, a kigawh ni mateng tuam koih in!

Gam sunga a tengte gitlohna hangin bang tanvei gamsung tau-in, lo khempeuh-a lopate vul ding ahi hiam? Amaute in, “Amah in i hun tawpna hong mu lo ding hi,” a ci uh ahih manin gamsate leh vasate mangthang hi.
Mite tawh na tai khop a, amaute in nang hong gimsak ahih leh, sakol bangci dem zawh ding na hi hiam? A nopna mun ah tuk lailai na hih leh, Yardan singkawm lakah bang cih ding na hi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cihleh na sanggamte nangawn leh na pa innkuan, amaute nangawn in nang hong lehhek uh hi. Hi hi, amaute nangawn in nakpi-in nang hong awtsan uh hi! Kam khum tawh nang hong hopih hangin amaute um kei in!
Ka Inn ka taisan khin a, Ka luahte ka nusia khin hi; Ka it mahmah ka mite a galte khut sungah ka pia khin hi.
Ka luahte pen Kei tungah gamlak-a humpineikai hong bang uh hi. Ka langah hong hawksan uh hi; tua ahih ciangin ka mudah hi.
Ka luahte pen Kei tungah sa sial ne vasa khat, a dang vasate in a kiimkot panin a tuk nainai bang hong hi uh hi. Hong pai un, gamlak gamsate khempeuh kaikhawm un! A netum dingin hong pai un!
Tuucing tampite in Ka leenggui lo susia khin uh a, Kei aa teng tuancil gawp uh hi; amaute in a nuam mahmah Ka leenggui lo leigawtak gamlak suaksak uh hi.
Amaute in gamgawtak suaksak uh ahih manin Kei tungah hong tau uh hi. Kuamah in kin lo ahih manin gam buppi gamgawtak suak hi.
Sehnelgam kantan-in mun sangte khempeuh ah a susiate tung khin hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ namsau in lei mong khat panin mong khat dong vat ding a, kuamah in lungmuanna nei lo ding hi.
Amaute in mangbuh vawh uh a, ahih hangin lingkung at uh hi; amau le mau gim kiguan uh a, bangmah a ngah kei uh hi. Yahweh’ heh mahmahna hangin an lak hun ciangin a maizum ding uh hi.
Ka mi Israyl-te’ luah dinga ka piak gamh a koih a gilo Ka vengte khempeuh langah Yahweh in ka gen inah: En un, a gam uh panin amau ka bot khia ding a, amau sung panin Yahdah mite ka bot khia ding hi.
Amaute ka bot khiat khit ciangin, Keimah paikik-in, amaute ka hehpih ding a, ka ciahpih kikin, a kuamapeuh amau luah ciat, amau leitang ciat ka pia kik ding hun hong tung ding hi.

Hih bangin hong piang ding hi: amaute in Baal;Topa, min tawh kiciam dingin Ka mite a hilh ngei bangun, “Yahweh nungta ahih manin” ci-in Ka Min tawh a kiciam dingin Ka mite’ ngeinate limtakin a sin uh leh, tua ciangin amaute pen Ka mite lakah kikipsak ding hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong man kei uh leh, tua minam botkhia kiuhkeuh-in, ka susia ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Yahweh in kei tungah hih bangin hong ci hi: Pai inla, puan kawnggak khat lei-in ka kawnggak in. Ahih hangin tui sungah diah kei in.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ kammal om bangin kawnggak khat lei-in ka kawng ka gak hi.
Yahweh’ kammal a nih vei-na kei tungah hong tungin, a gen inah:
Na kawnga om na leisa na kawnggak la-in, tho inla, Euphrates ah pai in; tua lai mun suang heng kawm ah seel in.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh hong thupiak bangin pai-in Euphrates gun gei-ah ka seel hi.
Tua zawh ni tampi khit ciangin Yahweh in kei tungah hong gen inah: Tho in; Euphrates ah pai inla, tua lai-ah kong seelsak kawnggak va la in.
Tua ciangin Euphrates ah pai-in ka to a, ka seelna mun panin tua kawnggak ka la hi. Kawnggak na kisia a, zat theih hi nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei hong hopih-in a gen inah:
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih bang mah-in Yahdah kiphatsakna leh Yerusalem a nak kiphatsakna ka susia ding hi.

Ka thute a ngai nuam lo, amau lungsim deihna bangin a gamta, a bia ding leh a na a sem dingin a kikham pasiante nung a zui hih mi siate pen a kizang thei nawn lo hih kawnggak tawh a kibang ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh kawnggak pen mihing kawng ah a vialh mah bangin, Israyl’ innkuan buppi leh Yahdah’ innkuan buppi ka mi ding, ka minthanna ding, hong kiphat nading leh hong kipahtawi nadingin Keima tungah ka kivialsak hi; ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong ngai nuam lo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute tungah hih thu gen in: Israyl’ Pa Yahweh in, “ Leenggahzu beel peuhmah leenggahzu tawh kidim ding hi!” hong ci hi, ci va ci in. Tua ciangin amaute in nang kiangah, “Leenggahzu khempeuh leenggahzu tawh a kidip ding lam kote in thei lo ka hi uh hiam?” hong ci ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute tungah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En un, David’ tokhom tunga tu kumpite, siampite, kamsangte leh Yerusalem khua-a teng mi khempeuh-a kipan gam sung-a om mikhempeueh zu tawh kidimsakin ka khamsak ding hi.
Pate leh tate a kipan, khat le khat ka kiphu gawp sak ding hi; Yahweh in kong cih inah: Hehpih loin, dawm loin, ka khual kei ding a, amaute ka susia ding hi,” ci-in na gen ding hi, hong ci hi.
Za unla, na bul uh ngat un! Kiphasak kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in gen khin hi.
Yahweh in khua a mialsak ma, khuamialna mual tungah na tuk ma-un, na lamet uh khuavak pen khuamial bikbek a suah ma-in, Yahweh na Pa uh pahtawi un.
Ahih hangin hih thu na ngaih kei uh leh, na kiphatsakna uh hangin ka kap sim ding a, khitui luangin nakpi takin ka kap ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ tuuhonte sal-in kikai zo hi.
Kumpipa tung leh a nu tungah gen un: Kiniam khiat unla, tutphah ngiam ah tu un. Bang hang hiam cihleh na minthanna kumpi-lukhu kiniamkoih ding hi, ci un.
Leitaw lam khuapite kikhak cip ding a, kuamah in hong lo ding hi. Yahdah salin kikai ding hi, a vekpi-in kikai ding hi; salin kipaipih siang kiuhkeuh ding hi.
Khuadak unla, leilu lam panin hong pai mite en un. No tunga hong kipia tuuhonte, na tuu hoihte uh koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Yahweh in na kipawlpih mite tektek nang tungah tusakin, nang hong uk dingin amaute a bawl ciangin bang gen nawn ding na hi hiam? Numei nausak khat bangin na sa mahmah ding hilo na hi hiam?
“Bang hangin hih thute kei tungah hong tung hiam?” ci-in na ngaihsut leh, a hang in: na mawhna tampite hangin na niksing hong kihawk gawp a, na khete kidawk hi.
Ethiopia mite in a ciseh khel thei-in, kamkei in a gial khek thei hileh, gamtat siatna a zongsang note zong na hoih gamtat kha thei ding uh hi!
Yahweh in, “Tua ahih ciangin sehnelgam huih in buhvai a muut thehthang gawp bangin amaute ka thehthang ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih in Kei kiang pana nangma tanh, nangma ngah ahi hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi: bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Kei hong nusia-in, Zuau; Baal, na um hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na zahmawh a kimuh nadingin na maitang dong ah na niksing ka lawnto ding hi.
Gamlak mual tung tengah a kihhuaite; (elohim, teraphim) tawh hukin na paktatna leh tau huthut-in na angkawmna ka mu khin hi! Yerusalem aw, na dahhuai hi! Bang tanvei ninnin lai ding na hi hiam?
Hih in guahtui ngah lo-a khuakeuna tawh kisai-in Yeremyah tungah a tung thu ahi hi:
Yahdah gam kap a, a kulh kongpite zawm hi. Amaute in a leitang kah uh a, Yerusalem panin kahna gingkhia hi.

A uliante un tui tawi dingin a nasemte sawl uh hi; amaute tuikhuk ah pai uh a, ahih hangin tui om lo hi. Amaute beel hawmguakin ciahkik uh hi. Amaute maizumin, lungkhamin cih nading thei loin a lu a khuh uh hi.
Leitung ah guah zuk lohna hangin leitang a keugaw ahih manin lokhote maizum uh a, a lu a khuh uh hi.
Hi hi, lopa om lo ahih manin gamlaka sazuk nangawn in a tanote nusia hi.
Gam-laate a sangna munte ah ding uh a, gam-uite bangin a nak haha uh hi. Lopa om lo ahih manin a hak zo kei uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka mawhnate un kote langah teci a pang hangin, Na Min na khual na-in khatpeuh hong sem in! Bang hang hiam cihleh tam veipi ka nungtolh uh a, Nang tungah ka mawh khin uh hi.
Israyl’ Lamet pa, haksat hun ciangin kote hong Honpa aw, hih gam sungah bang hangin hong midangtat na hi hiam?

Bang hangin mi lungkia gawp khat bangin, a kisap penpen hun ah a huh zo lo galkap khat bangin om na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, kote lakah nangmah omin, Na Min tawh kote hong kilo hi; kote hong nusia kei in!

Hih mite tungah Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Amaute in vak kawikawi nuamsa uh a, a kidek kei uh hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in amaute sang lo hi; Amah in tu-in amau khialhna phawk ding a, a mawhna uh a dantat ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kiangah, “Hih mite nopsak nadingin thungen kei in.

Amaute in an a tan ciangin amau kikona ka ngai kei ding a, meihal biakpiakna leh an tawh biakpiakna hong piak uh ciangin, ka sang kei ding hi. Tua banah amaute namsau, kialpi leh pulpi tawh amaute ka susia ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ah, Yahweh ka Pa aw! En in, kamsangte in amaute kiangah, ‘Namsau na mu kha kei ding uh a, kialpi zong na thuak kei ding uh hi; Yahweh in hih mun ah tawntung nopna hong pia ding hi,’ ci uh hi,” ka ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kiangah, “Kamsangte in Ka Min tawh zuau gen uh hi! Amaute ka sawl kei a, thu zong pia loin, amaute zong ka hopih kei hi! Amaute in a man lo maang muhnate, pasian biakna thu—amau ngaihsut tawm khemnate nang tungah hong gen uh hi!

Tua ahih ciangin amaute ka sawl loh hangin Keima Min tawh kamsangin, ‘Namsau leh kialpi hih gam sungah om lo ding hi,’ a ci kamsangte tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hih bangin kong ci hi: tua kamsangte mahmah zong namsau leh kialpi tawh a si ding uh hi!

A hilh uh mite zong kialpi leh namsau hangin Yerusalem kongzing lakah kilawn mang ding uh hi. Amaute, a zite, a tapate leh a tanute uh a vui ding om lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute tungah amau gitlohna mah ka buak ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in amaute tungah hih thu gen in: ‘Sun leh zanin ka khitui luang henla, kang ngei kei hen! Bang hang hiam cihleh ka mite’ ta nungak nakpi takin kisatna leh vuak gawpna tawh a liam khin hi.
Gamsung ah pai leng namsau-a kithatte ka mu a, khua sungah lut leng, kialpi a thuakte ka mu hi! Hi hi, kamsangte leh siampite a theih loh gam ah a pai kawikawi uh hi,’ ci in,” hong ci hi.

Nangmah in Yahdah nial taktak na hi hiam? Zion kih ta na hi hiam? Kote ka dam zawh loh dongin bang hangin kote hong sat na hi hiam? Kote in kilemna ka lamen uh a, ahih hangin kilemna a om kei hi; cidamna hun i lamen uh a, ahih hangin gimna a om hi.
Yahweh aw, kote gitlohna leh ka pu pa pate uh khialhna kong pulak uh hi; bang hang hiam cileh Nang tungah kong mawh khin uh hi.
Na Min na khualna-in kote hong kih kei in! Nangma minthang tokhom pahtawi lo kei in! Yahweh aw, phawk in! Kote tawh nong thuciamna palsat kei in!

Gentile mite’ a mawknapite; elohim, lakah guah a zusak thei om ahi hiam? Vantungte in ama thu a guahzusak ahi hiam? Yahweh kote Pa aw, tua bang ahih nangmah hilo na hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin hih nate khempeuh nangma bawlsa ahih manin nangmah kong lamen ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kaingah, “Keima mai-ah a thuumsak dingin Mosheh leh Samuyl hong ding leh zong, hih mite ka hehpih tuan kei ding hi. Ka mun panin amaute hawl khia in! Amaute paikhia sak in!

Tua ciangin amaute in nang kiangah, ‘Koi-ah pai ding ka hi uh hiam?’ hong cih leh, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Sihna aa dingte sihna ah; namsau aa dingte namsau ah, kialpi aa dingte kialpi ah, salmat aa dingte sal ah,’ ci in’ hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin amaute tungah siatna nam li ka tungsak ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi: a that lum dingin namsau, a tuahmang dingin ui, a valh tum ding leh a susia dingin huih lak vasate leh leilak gamsate ahi hi.
Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah’ tapa Menasheh hang leh Yerusalem ah ama bawl thu hangin leitung kumpigam khempeuh ah amaute muhdahhuai ka suaksak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yerusalem aw, kua in nang hong hehpih ding ahi hiam? Ahih keileh kua in nang hong kah ding ahi hiam? Ahih keileh na omzia dong dingin kua hong lambaang ding ahi hiam?
Nangmah in Kei nong taisan khin hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi: nong nungngatsan khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin nangma langah ka khut ka zan khia ding a, kong susia ding hi; Ka ki-ipipna-in ka gimta hi.
Gam sung kulh kongpi ah an zaapna tawh amaute ka zaap ding hi; Amaute in a lampite uh a khel loh nungsangin a tate uh ka taansak ding a, Ka mite ka susia ding hi.

Tuipi sehnel sangin meigong nupite ka tamsakzaw ding hi; Amaute tung, tapa khanglai nei nupite tungah suntangpi-a a susiapa ka paisak ding a, amaute tungah thakhatthu-in lungkhamna leh launa ka tungsak ding hi.

Ta sagih nei nupi nu khakham vei-in a husam hi; Sun kimlai mah-in ama ni tum a, amah maizumin lungmang hi. Amaute a omlaisun teng a galte uh mai-ah namsau aa dingin ka pia ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Ka nu aw, gam buppi tawh a kitawng kisel keimah ta-in nong neih sese! A met dingin leiba ka pia kei a, mi kiang ah zong ka ba kei hi; tua hi napi-in amaute a kuamapeuh in kei hong samsia uh hi!
Yahweh in, “A taktakin na mi a omlaisunte aa dingin a hoih ding hi; haksat hun leh lungkham hun ciangin na galte nang tungah kong thuumsak taktak ding hi.
Sik in leilu lam sik leh sumngo sutan thei ding ahi hiam?
Na gam sung teng-a na mawhnate khempeuh hangin na neih na lam uh leh na sum na paite uh manh piak loh vansuh bangin ka pia mang ding hi.
Na theih ngei loh gam sungah na galte tawh kong paisak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note tunga a kuang ding meikuang ka hehna tawh kitawh hi,” ci hi.

Yahweh aw, a vekpi-in na thei hi; hong phawk inla, hong veh in; kei hong bawlsiate tungah kei aa ding phu hong laksak in. Nong thuak keeikaai-na hangin kei hong susia kei in. Nangmah ka cihna hangin mawhsakna ka thuakna hong thei in.
Na thute kimu-in, ka ne hi; Vanglian Yahweh ka Pa aw, kei tungah Na Min hong kilo ahih manin na thute kei aa dingin kipakna leh ka lungsim ah nuamna ahi hi.
Mi zahpihte lakah ka tu kei a, zong nuam ka sa kei hi. Nangma khut hangin kei bek mah ka tu hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in lungkim lohna tawh kei nong kidimsak hi.
Bang hangin ka natna in tawp hun nei lo a, ka liamna dam thei loin, dam nuam mahmah lo ahi hiam? Kei aa dingin Nang pen a keu wadi lui, tui om lo lui tawh hong kibang ding na hi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Na kisik leh, kong koihna ngei ah kong koih ding hi; tua ciangin Keima mai-ah na ding ding hi. A thutang lote kiang panin a thumaan mite na paikhiatpih leh, nang in Keima kam na hi ding hi. Amaute nang lamah kiheisak inla, ahih hangin amau lamah nang kihei peuhmah kei in.

Hih mite aa dingin nang pen a muanhuai sumnngo kulh kong hisak ding a, amaute in nang hong do ding uh hi. Ahih hangin nang tungah amaute gualzo lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a hong honkhia ding leh a hong suaktasak dingin nang kong om pih hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Migilote khut panin nang kong suaktasak ding a, a lipkhaphuai mite’ khut panin nang kong tan ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh thu kei tungah hong tungin, a gen inah:
Zi na la kei ding a, hih mun ah tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin na nei kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh hih mun-a a suak tapate leh tanute tawh kisai, hih leitang ah amaute a suakkhia a nute leh amaute a ngah a pate uh tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi:

Amaute a lipkhaphuai sihna tawh si ding uh hi! Amaute kikah lo ding a, zong kivui lo ding hi; Lei maitang ah ki-ek nusiat ding hi. Namsau leh kialpi in amaute simang ding uh a, amau luanghawmte van-a vasate leh leitung ganhingte aa dingin an ahi ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Kahna inn ah lut kei in; tamlo ding ahi a, amaute a kah ding ahi zongin pai kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih mite kiang panin Ka lungmuansakna, Ka itna leh ka hehpihna nangawn ka lakhia khin hi, Yahweh in ka ci hi.
Hih gam ah aneu a lian si ding uh hi. Amaute kivui lo ding a, amau aa dingin tamlawhna om lo ding a, a pumpi uh a kui liam, a sam uh a met om lo ding hi.
Misi hanga a kapte hehnem dingin kuamah in an a lui kei ding uh hi; a nu a pate hangin a kapte dawn dingin hehnepna hai zong a pia kei ding uh hi.
Tua banah amaute tawh a tu-in a ne a dawn dingin pawi bawlna inn sungah zong na lut kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ Pa, vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, note muh tektek leh no nuntak sung mahin hih mun panin lungdamna leh kipakna aw, mopa leh monu aw beisak ding hi.

Hici bangin hong piang ding hi: Hih kammalte khempeuh hih mite kiangah na lak ciangin amaute in nang kiangah, “Bang hangin Yahweh in eite langah hih bang siatna lianpite khempeuh genkhia ahi hiam? Ahih keileh I khialhna bang ahi hiam? Ahih keileh Yahweh i Pa tungah i khialh theih nadingin i mawhna bang ahi hiam?” hong ci ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, “Bang hang hiam cihleh na pu na pate un Kei hong taisan uh hi! Yahweh in ci hi. Amaute in a kikham pasiante nung zui khin uh a, tuate’ na semin, a bia uh hi! Amaute in Ka Thukham zuih lohna tawh Kei hong taisan uh hi!

Tua banah note in na pu na pate uh sangin a suksiazaw-in na gamta uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh en un, note in na lungsim siapi uh tawh no hoihsak tawm ngaihsutna ciat na zui uh hi; tua ahih ciangin kuamah in Ka thu hohng ngai lo hi!

Tua ahih ciangin hih gam panin note ahi a, na pu na pate un ahi zongin a theih ngei loh uh gam ah kong lawnkhia ding hi; note kong angvan lohna tua lai mun-ah sun leh zanin hih a kikham pasiante’ na nasem ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en un, Yahweh in ci hi: ‘Egypt gam panin Israyl mite hong paikhiatpih Yahweh nungta ahih manin’ a kicih nawn loh ding hun hong tung hi.

Ahih hangin ‘A kepna mun pan leh amaute a notkhiatna gam khempeuh panin Israyl mite a paikhiatpih Yahweh nungta ahih manin’ kici ding hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh a pu a pate tungah ka piak amau gam sungah amaute ka paipih kik ding hi!

En un, ngabeng mi tampi ka sawl ding a, amaute in nga beng ding uh hi; tua khit ciangin sabeng mi tampi ka sawl ding a, amaute in mual lian tung khempeuh leh mual neu tung khempeuh, suangheng kawmte ah beng ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute paina khempeuh ka mu hi; Ka maitang panin amaute kiseel lo a, Ka mit panin zong amau khialhnate a kiseel kei hi.

Ahih hangin a khialhna leh a mawhna uh hangin a zah nih-in ka thuk ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ka gam ninsak khin uh a, a lungsim nat huai leh a kihuai a pasian’ luanghawmte uh tawh ka gam kidimsak uh hi,” hong ci hi.

Aw Yahweh, ka hatna leh ka kulhpi, ka lungkham hun ciangin ka bukna aw, leimong panin nang kiangah Gentile mite hong pai-in, “Ka pu ka pate un zuauthu leh bangmah-a kimang lo pasiante longal bangmah a nei kei uh hi!” hong ci ding uh hi.
Mihingte in amau aa dingin pasiante bawl uh ahi hiam? Bawl uh hi, ahih hangin tuate in vangliatna a nei kei hi!
Tua ahih ciangin en un, amaute ka theisak ding hi—hih hun-in Ka vangliatna leh ka thahatna amaute ka hilh ding a, amaute in Ka Min Yahweh ahih lam thei ding uh hi.
Yahdah’ mawhna sik laikung tawh kigelh a, a lungtang satak peek tung leh a biaknatau kite tungah suang manpha mukzum tawh kikui kuakin ki-at hi.
A tate un mual sangte tung-a singkung niimte banah a biaknataute leh a siangtho khuampite; Asherim, nangawn a phawk lai uh hi.
Hih gam sunga Ka muallian aw, na hauhna, na neihsate khempeuh leh na tenna khempeuh uh ah na mawhna uh munsangte khempeuh galmat ka suaksak ding hi.

Nang, nangmah mah in zong, Keima kong piaksa gamh na taan ding a, tua ciangin na theih lohna gam ah na galte’ nasem kong suaksak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in a kuang tawntung ding Ka hehna na tawh kuang hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Mi muangin, mi hatna suangin, a lungsim Yahweh kiang pan a pialkhia mi in hamsiat ngah ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen sehnel gam sungah sawlbawk bang hi a, gawlzawhna peuhmah a mu kei ding hi; kuama ten lohna ci gam, sehnel gam sung keugaw munte ah a teng ding hi.
Yahweh muangin Yahweh a lamen mi in thupha ngah ahi hi!

Bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen tui kianga kisuan, gungei-a zung a kha singkung tawh kibang ding a, a sat hun ciangin zong lau lo ding hi. A tehte hing den ahih manin guah zuk loh kumin zong lunghimawh lo ding a, a gah ding zong tawp lo ding hi.
Lungsim pen na khempeuh sangin a khemhatzaw leh a gilo mahmah zaw hi a, kua in thei ding ahi hiam?
Keimah, Yahweh in mi khempeuh amau gamtatna leh amau sepna gah tawh kizui-in a pia dingin a lungtang kantelin, a lungsim ka sittel hi.
Thumaan lo tawh hauhna a ngah mi pen ama tui lopi a op valah tawh kibang hi; A khan kimtan ciangin a huahna in nusia ding a, a hun tawpna amah thu-in kisim lo ding hi.
A kipat cil-a kipanin a minthang a sang tokhom pen i munsiangtho a omna mun ahi hi.

Israyl’ Lametna ahi Yahweh aw, Nang hong taisan khempeuh a maizum ding uh hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh hih Kei kiang panin a taikhiate leilak-a kigelh a suak ding hi, kici hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Nuntakna Tuite Naak ahi Yahweh a nusia khin uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nang hong phat ka hih manin hong damsak in; tua ciangin ka dam ding hi! Hong honkhia in, tua ciangn ka suakta ding hi.
En in, amaute in kei kiangah, “Yahweh’ thugen koi-ah om hiam? Tu-in hong tangtun hen!” hong cici uh hi.
Kei ka hih leh, Nangmah hong zui tuucing khat ka hihna panin ka puk kei a, siatna ni a tun ding zong ka deih kei hi. Ka kammalte Nangma kiang pana hong pai ahihna na thei hi!
Kei hong lausak kei in; haksat hun ciangin ka lametna Nang na hi hi.

Kei hong bawlsiate maizum sak inla, ahih hangin kei hong maizum sak kei in! Amaute lausak inla, ahih hangin kei hong lausak kei in! Amaute tungah gimna ni tungsak inla, a zah nih-a suksiatna tawh amaute susia in!
Yahweh in kei kiangah hih bangin hong ci hi: Pai inla, Yahdah kumpite a sungtum a pusuahna, mipite kongpi ah ding in; Yerusalem kongpi adangte khempeuh ah zong ding inla,
amaute kiangah, “No Yahdah kumpite aw, Yahdah khempeuh leh hih kongpi tawnin a lut Yerusalem-a tengte khempeuh tawh Yahweh’ kammal za un! ci in.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Shabbat ni-in vangik puak ding ahi a, Yerusalem kongpite tawnin puak ding ahi zongin kidawm un.
Shabbat ni-in na innte uh panin vangik puakhia kei unla, na sep khatpeuh zong sem kei un; tua sangin na pu na pate ka thupiak bangin Shabbat ni a siangtho-in zang un.
Ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong mang loin, a bil hong ngat lo uh a, a ngawng khauhsak uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in ka thu ngai loin, ka hilhna sang lo uh hi.

Hihci bangin hong piang ding hi, Yahweh in kong cih inah: Ka thu limtakin nong ngaih uh a, Shabbat ni-in hih khuapi kongpite tawnin hakkol pua loin tua ni-in nasep khatpeuh sep lohna tawh Shabbat ni a siangtho-in na zat uh leh—

David kumpi-tokhum tunga a tu kumpite, a uliante tawh hih khupi kongpite ah sakollengte leh sakolte tung tuangin lut ding uh hi; amaute leh a uliante tawh Yahdah mite leh Yerusalem-a tengte tonkhawm ding a, hih khuapi om paisuak ding hi.

Tua ciangin Yahdah khuapite leh Yerusalem kiim-a munte—Benyamin gam pan leh nitumna lam mualbulte pan, mualtung gam pan leh Leitawlam panin Yahweh’ Inn ah meihal biaknate leh biakpiaknate, an tawh biaknate leh paknamtuite pua-in, phatna biakpiaknate tawh amaute hong pai ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin Shabbat ni-in Yerusalem kongpite tawnin na pai ciangun hakkol puakna leh Shabbat ni a siangtho-a zat lohna tawh Ka thu nong man kei uh leh, a kongpite ah mei ka thawh kuang ding a, tua in Yerusalem kumpi-innte kangtum ding a, a mit kei ding hi, ci in,” hong ci hi.
Hih in Yahweh kiang pana Yeremyah tunga a tung thu ahi hi:
“Tho inla, beelsekpa’ inn ah pai suk in; tua lai-ah Ka kammal kong zasak ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin beelsekpa’ inn ah ka pai suk a, beel peina ah a nasep laitak ka tuak hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tungman tawh a bawl beel pen beelsekpa’ khut ah kisia hi; tua ahih ciangin beelsekpa in hoih a sakpen bangin zuunin beel dang khatin a bawl kik hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ kammal kei tungah hong tunga,
“Israyl’ innkuan aw, hih beel bangin nang hong bawl thei hilo ahi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi: En un, beelsekpa’ khut sunga tungman bangin, Israyl’ innkuan aw, Keima khut sungah na om uh hi.
Minam khatpeuh ahih keileh gam khatpeuh tawh kisai-in botkhiat siang kiuhkeuh ding leh suksiat dingin hun khatpeuh ah thakhat thu-in ka tangko ding a,
ahih hangin ka vauhilhsa tua minam a siatna panin a kisik leh, tua ciangin amaute tunga hih dingin ka sehsa gimna ka tungsak nawn kei ding hi.
Minam khatpeuh ahih keileh gam khatpeuh lam ding leh phut dingin a hun dang khatpeuh ah thakhat thu-in ka tangko ding a,
ahih hangin Ka muhna ah a sia-in gamta-in, Ka thu hong man keileh, tua ciangin phattuamna ka pia ding hi ci-in ka gen thu leh hoihna ka tungsak nawn kei ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Yahdah mite tung leh Yerusalem-a tengte tungah Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: En un, note tungah siatna ka geel a, note langah ngimna ka nei hi. A kuamapeuh tu-in siattatna panin kihei unla, na zia na tong uh hoihsak un!
Ahih hangin amaute in, ‘Lametna vet om kei! Tua ahih ciangin ko ngimna bangin ka zui ding uh a, ka vekpi-un ko lungsim sia’ ngaihsutna bangin ka gamta ding uh hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi, a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Minamte lakah tu-in dong un; kua in tua bang thute za ngei ahi hiam? Nungak Israyl in a mulkimhuai mahmah na sem khin ta hi!
Mi in gam sung suangpi pana hong luang Lebanon Mual-a vuk-tui luang nusia ding ahi hiam? A mun dang pana hong luang tui vot silsial kinusia ding ahi hiam?

Tua hinapi-in Ka mite in Kei hong mangngilh khin uh a, tanglai lampite panin a pialsak, amau lampi ah a muktusak bangmah-a kimang lote tungah gimnamtui a hal uh hi. Tuate in lampi lopi zuisak a, a kisial lampi tung a tawn kei uh hi.
Amau gam a siasak ding leh simmawhna tawh a kiphitsan den ding gam a suaksak uh hi; tua lai a nawk khempeuh lipkhap-in a lu a peisan ding uh hi.
Nisuahna lam huih tawh a lengkhawm bangin a galpa mai-ah amaute ka thehthang ding hi; Amau gim thuak ni ciangin Ka mai lam ngat loin Ka nung ka ngat ding hi!” hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, “Hong pai un! Yeremyah langah sawmsim ni! Bang hang hiam cihleh siampite kiang panin Thukham sunga thuhilhna ahi a, mipilte kiang panin kuppihna ahi a, kamsangte kiang pana thu ahi zongin mangthang lo ding hi. Hong pai un! I leii tawh amah do-in, ama hong gen peuhmah thusim kei ni,” a ci uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka thu hong za inla, kei hong kimawhsakna thute hong ngai in!

Hoihna pen siatna tawh kithuk ding ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in ka nuntakna thangsiah-in dum a to uh hi. Na hehna amau tungah a tun loh nadingin amau tangin thugen dingin Nangma mai-ah kong dinna phawk in.

Tua ahih manin a tate uh kialpi tungah pia inla, namsau hatna tawh amau sisante buakhia in! A zite uh tasel sak inla, meigong suaksak in! A pasalte uh pulpi betmang suaksak inla, a tangvalte uh gal sungah namsau tawh sisak in!
Amaute thakhat-a sim dingin galkap honte na paisak ciangin amau kahna a inn panun kiza tahen! Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in kei hong mat dingin dum to uh a, ka khe thang hong siahsim uh hi.

Tua hinapi-in Yahweh aw, kei hong thah theih nadingun kei tunga amau hong sawmsimna khempeuh na thei hi. Amau khialhnate maisak kei inla, Na muhna panin amau mawhna zong phiatkhia kei in! Tua banah Na mai-ah amaute lawnthal inla, Na heh hun ciangin amaute hih bangin hih in.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: “Pai inla, beelsekpa’ leibeel khat lei in; mipi upate pawlkhat leh siampi khanghamte pawlkhat tonpih in.
Tua ciangin Beelthem Kongpi lutna gei-a om Ben Hinnom Kuam ah pai inla, kong gen ding thute tua lai-ah tangko in.

“Yahdah kumpite leh Yerusalem-a tengte aw, Yahweh’ kammal za un. Vanglian Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, hih mun ah kog tunsak ding siatna lian lua ahih manin tua thu a za peuhmah, a bil uh ah ging den ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Kei hong taisan-in, amaute ahi a, a pu a pate un ahi zongin a theih ngei loh uh a kikham pasiante tungah gimnamtui biakna halna tawh hih mun a ninsak khin uh a, Yahdah kumpite in hih mun ah mawhbaang lo sisan a dimsak uh hi;

tua banah Baal tungah meihal biakpiakna-in a tapate uh mei tawh a hal nadingun Baal aa dingin munsangte zong a lam uh a, tua pen cikma-in thu ka piak ngei loh, zong ka gen ngei loh leh, Ka lungsim-a om a om ngei peuhmah lo ahi hi!
Tua ahih ciangin en un, a hun hong tung ta hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi: Hih mun pen Tophet ahi a, Ben Hinnom Kuam ahi zongin kici nawn lo ding a, Thahna Kuam kici ding hi.

Tua hi a, hih mun ah Yahdah leh Yerusalem’ ngimna ka siasak ding a, a galte uh mai-ah namsa leh amau nuntakna thah dingin a zong mite khut tawh ka puksak ding hi; a luanghawmte uh van-a vasate leh leitung gamsate an dingin ka pia ding hi.
Hih khuapi ka hawmsuaksak ding a, a simmawh huai ka suaksak ding hi. Tua teng a nawk mi peuhmah in tua khuapi thuak siatna hangin lipkhap-in a phitsan ding uh hi.
A galte uh leh amau nuntakna thah dingin a zong mite lungkhamsakna tawh lamet a bei hun-in, a tanu a tapate’ sa ka ne sak ding a, a kuamapeuh in umcihna sunga om a lawm’ sa ne ding uh hi,” ci in.
Tua ciangin na tonpih mite muh-in leibeel na sukham ding a,

amaute kiangah, “Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: A kibawl pha kik thei lo a kisukham beelsekpa’ beel bangin hih mite leh hih khuapi ka sukham ding hi. Vui nading mun a om nawn loh dongin Tophet ah amaute kivui ding uh hi.
Yahweh in kong cih inah: hih mun leh a sunga tengte tungah ka hih zia ding tua bang hi a, hih khuapi Tophet ka bangsak ding hi.

Innkhum tung pan amaute in vantung a honpite khempeuh tungah paknamtui a halna-in a kikham pasiante tungah dawn-a biakna a sunkhiatna uh innte khempeuh hangin Yerusalem-a innte leh Yahdah kumpite’ innte Tophet mun bangin a nin ding hi,” gen in hong ci hi.
