Tua ciangin Yahweh in kamsang dingin a sawlna mun Tophet panin Yeremyah pai-in, Yahweh’ Inn tual ah ding a, mi khempeuh kiangah:

“Vanglian Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, Ka kammalte ngaih loh nadingun amaute un a ngawng uh khauhsak ahih manin, hih khuapi tung leh a khua khempeuh tungah amau tunga tung dingin ka gensa siatna khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi, ci hi,” ci-in gen hi.
Tu-in Immer’ tapa siampi Pashhur, Yahweh’ Inn ah ukpipa zong ahipa in Yeremyah’ kamsan hih thute a za hi.
Tua ciangin Pashhur in kamsang Yeremyah satin, Yahweh’ Inn-a Benyamin’ Kongpi tungnung-a om thong sungah a koih hi.

A zing ciangin hi bangin hong piang hi, Pashhur in a thong panin Yeremyah paikhiasak hi. Tua ciangin Yeremyah in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in na min Pashhur; Suakta, ci-in hong sam nawn lo a, Magor-Missabib; Mun khempeuh launa, ci-in hong sam ta hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, nangma tung mahmah leh na lawmte khempeuh tungah launa khatin nang kong bawl ding hi. A galte namsau tawh amaute si ding a, na mit tawh na mu ding hi! Keimah in Yahdah khempeuh Babylon’ kumpipa khut sungah ka pia ding a, amah in Babylon ah salin paipih ahih keileh namsau tawh a that ding hi.

Tua bek tham loin hih khuapi’ hauhna khempeuh, a neihsa khempeuh, a van thupi teng khempeuh leh Yahdah kumpite’ sum leh pai khempeuhte a galte uh khut sungah ka pia ding a, amaute in sutin, man-in, Babylon ah a paipih ding hi.

Pashhur aw, nang leh na inn sunga a tengte khempeuh galmatin na pai ding uh hi. Nang leh na zuau kamsanna a ngai na lawmte khempeuh Babylon ah na pai ding uh a, tua lai-ah si-in hong kivui ding hi,”a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, kei nong zol a, zol ka thuak hi; kei sangin nang na hatzaw a, kei nong zo hi. Ni simin ciamnuihna-in hong kinei a, a kuamapeuh in hong zahko hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh thu ka gen simim, “Nongtatna leh siatna!” ci-in awngin ka kiko den hi. Aw, Yahweh’ kammal ka genna hangin nisim-in zahpihna leh kona ka thuak den hi!

Tua ciangin keimah in, “Ama thu ka gen kei ding a, a Min zong ka lo nawn kei ding hi,” ka ci hi. Ahih hangin Ama thu ka lungsim sungah meikuang bangin hong om a, ka guh ka tang sungah kikhum cip ahih manin ka ipipna hangin gim lua-in, gen loin ka om thei kei hi!

Huau-na tampi ka za a, “Magor-Missabib; Mun khempeuh ah launa, amah pholak un! Amah pholak ni!” hong kici hi. Ka lawm a kici khempeuh in ka puk ding hong en gige-in, “Amah kikhem zo kha ding ding hi; tua hileh amah langah i gualzo ding a, a phu i la zo ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in a thahat galhang khat bangin kei hong ompih hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei hong bawlsiate kituk ding uh a, a gualzo kei ding uh hi. Amaute gualzo lo ding uh ahih manin nakpi takin maizum ding uh a, a tawntunga amau mindaina kimangngilh ngei kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin vanglian Yahweh aw, a thumaan mite a entel, lungsim leh ngaihsutna a mu nangmah in amau tungah na thuhkikna hong musak in; bang hang hiam cihleh nang tungah ka thu kong ap khin hi.
Yahweh tungah la sa un! Yahweh phat un! Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in siatna a bawl mite’ khut panin mi cimawhte a honkhia hi!
Ka suah ni in hamsiatna thuak tahen! Ka nu in kei a hong suahkhiat ni in thupha ngah kei tahen!
Ka pa kiangah, “Tapa khat na nei hi,” ci-in a lungdamsak thu puakpa in hamsiatna ngah tahen.
Yahweh in hehpih loin a a lumlet khuapi tawh tua mipa kibang hen! Zingsangin gal hu ging za henla, sunin patau-a otna aw za hen;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in ka nu gil hong that lo hi! Ka ka han hi hoh henla, ka nu gil ah a omsuak hi hoh leng maw.
Bang hangin lungkhamna leh dahna mu ding leh maizumna tawh ka hun a bei dingin gil sung panin suakkhia laizang ka hi hiam?
Kumpi Zedekyah in Yeremyah kiangah Melchiyah’ tapa Pashhur leh Maaseyah’ tapa Zephanyah a sawl lai-in Yahweh kiang panin Yeremyah tungah thu tung hi.

“Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzer in kote hong sim ahih manin ko aa dingin Yahweh kiangah thu hong dotsak in. Amah ko kiang pan a paikhiat theih nadingin Yahweh in ama na lamdang septe khempeuh tawh kizui-in hong panpih kha thei ding hi,” ci-in a sawl ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Yeremyah in amaute kiangah, “Zedekyah tungah hih bangin na gen ding uh hi;

Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En in, kulh pualam pana note hong umcih Babylon kumpipa leh Chaldea mite na dona uh, na khut sung uh a galvante note lam-ah a hei ding ka hi ta a, hih khuapi laizangah amaute ka kaikhawm ding hi.
Keimahmah in hehna, lungsona leh nakpi-a thangpaihna tawh ka ban zanin, a hat ka khut tawh note kong do ding hi:
khuapi sunga tengte mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh ka vat ding a, amaute pulpi tawh a si ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in kong cih inah:Yahdah kumpiipa Zedekyah, a uliante, mipite leh pulnatna, namsau leh kialpi panin a nungta lai teng pen Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar khut sung, a galte uh khut sung leh amau nuntakna thah dinga a zong mite khut sungah ka pia ding hi. Amah in namsau tawh that ding a, dopbawl loin, lai-nat lo ding a, zong a hehpih kei ding hi.
Tu-in hih mite tungah thu na gen ding hi; Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: “En un, note mai-ah nuntakna lampi leh sihna lampi ka khung hi.

Hih khuapi sungah a om peuhmah namsau, kialpi leh pulnatna tawh si ding hi; ahih hangin paikhia-in note hong umcih Chaldea mite tungah a kipiakhia mi nungta ding a, a nuntakna gal antah a bang ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh hoih nading hilo, a siat nadingin hih khuapi tungah Ka mai ka ngat khin hi, Yahweh ka ci hi. Babylon kumpipa khut sungah hih khuapi kipia ding a, amah in mei tawh a hal ding hi.
Yahdah kumpipa’ innkuan tawh kisai-in, gen in; “Yahweh’ kammal za un:

David innkuan aw! Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Zingsangin thuthang thukhen unla, a nengniampa khut panin a kisutgawppa hukhia un; tua bang hi keileh amau gamtat siatna hangin Ka sinsona kuama phelh zawh loh meikuang bangin paikhia ding hi.
En un, eite langah kua pang zo ding hiam? I omna ah kua hong lut zo ding hiam a ci kuam sunga tengte leh gamlak a belte aw, note langah ka pang hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Tua hi a, note gamtatna gah tawh kituakin kong dantat ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi; Na tulak uh mei-in ka hal ding a, tua in a kiimkot khempeuh a kangtum mang ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Yahdah kumpipa inn ah paisuk inla, tua lai-ah hih thu gen in:
“David’ kumpi-tokhom-a tu Yahdah kumpipa aw, nang leh na uliante leh hih kongpite ah a lut na mite in Yahweh’ kammal za un.

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Thumaan leh thutang sem unla, a nengniam mite khut sung panin a bawlsiat a thuakte honkhia un. Khialhna bawl kei unla, peemtate, pa nei lote leh meigongte tungah ngongtat loin, hih mun ah mawhbang lo sisan zong luangsak kei un.

Bang hang hiam cihleh hih thute limtakin na zuih uh leh, David kumpi-tokhom tungah a tu kumpite, sakol tung leh leeng tung tuangin, a uliante leh a mite in zui-in hih inn kongpite sungah a lut ding om tawntung ding hi.
Ahih hangin hih thute na ngaih kei uh leh, tua ciangin Yahweh in kong cih inah, hih inn gamlak suaksak dingin Keimahmah in kong ciam hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah kumpi inn tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Nang pen Kei aa dingin Gilead, Lebanon’ lutang na hi hi; tua hi napi-in a kiten lohna khuapi, gamlak-in nang kong bawl taktak ding hi!
Nangma langah amau galvan ciat tawh a om a susiate ka kitawisak ding a, amaute in na tamtak khuam hoihte phuktan-in, mei sungah a lawn ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, minam tampite in hih khuapi nawkin pai ding uh a, a kuamapeuh in a vengte kiangah, ‘Bang hangin Yahweh in hih a lian khuapi hici bawl ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in dawngin, ‘Amaute in Yahweh a Pa’ thuciamna taisanin, a kikham pasiante bia-in tuate’ na a sepna uh hang ahi hi!’ a ci ding uh hi,” va ci in, hong ci hi.
A sisa kah kei unla, khasiat kei un; a paikhia dingpa nakpi-in kahzaw un; bang hang hiam cihleh amah hong ciahkik nawn lo ding a, a pianna gam a mukik nawn kei ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah kumpi Yoshiyah’ tapa Shallum (Yahahaz), a pa Yoshiyah kumpi-tokhom a luahpa tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: “hih mun panin a paikhiapa hih mun-ah ciahkik nawn peuhmah lo ding a,
salin a kaihna mun-ah si-in, hih gam a mukha nawn kei ding hi.
Thumaan loin a inn lamin, thutan lohna tawh a inndei a lam mi, thaman pia loin a vengpa na semsakin, a nasepna thaman bangmah a pia lo mi in gimna thuak tahen.
Amah in ‘Inndeite golsakin, inn zapi khat ka lam ding hi,’ ci-a, a tawlet vangte bawlin, taamtak singpek tawh thuap sawn a, a san za a zut hi.
Kumpi khat hihna pen tamtak innte sungah nuamtaka om theihna peuhsa na hi hiam? Na pa in ne-in dawnin, thumaan leh thutang tawh nasem hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin amah a daupai hi.
Amah in mizawngte leh mi cimawhte’ thu panpih a, na khempeuh hoih pah hi. Tu-a banga hihna in Kei nong theihna hilo ahi hiam? Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Tua hinapi-in na mit leh na lungtang in bangmah lopi teng ngim a, huaihamna, mawhbang lo sisan suahna, mi simmawhna leh ngongtat ding bek na sawm hi,” a ci hi.

Tua bek tham loin, Yahdah kumpi, Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahyakim tawh kisai-in Yahweh gen hih bang ahi hi: ‘Aw, ka sanggampa! Aw, ka sanggam nu!’ ci-in amaute in amah tamlawh lo ding uh hi. ‘Aw, kumpipa! Aw, na thupitna!’ ci-in amaute in tamlawh lo ding uh hi.
Amah pen laa kivui bangin kivui ding a, kikaitaal-in Yerusalem kongpi gal pek ah kipaai ding hi.
Lenbanon ah paito inla, awng in; Bashan ah na aw ngaihsak in; Abarim panin kiko in; bang hang hiam cihleh na itte khempeuh; na pawlte, kisia khin ta hi.
Na lungmuan laitakin kong hopih a, ahih hangin nangmah in, “Ka ngai kei ding hi!” na ci hi. Hih pen na neu tuung-a kipanin Ka thu nong man noploh na ngeina ahi hi.
Huih in na tuucingte khempeuh; ukpite, mutkhia mang ding a, na itte; na pawlte, salin pai ding uh hi; tua ciangin na maizum ding a, na gitlohna khempeuh hangin na lungzing taktak ding hi.
No tamtak sungah bu a tom, Lebanon-a tengte aw, nupi nausuak bangin na-in no tungah gimna hong tun vat ciangin na hehpihhuai mahmah ding uh hi!
Keimah a nungta ka hih mah bangin Yahweh in kong cih inah: Yahdah kumpi, Yahyakim’ tapa Conyah (Yahyakin) Ka taklam khut tunga minthuhna khutbuh na hih hangin kong botkhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin Keimah in na nuntakna thah dingin a zong mite khut sung leh na kihtak mite khut sung; Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar khut sung leh Chaldea mite khut sungah nang kong pia ding hi.
Na suahna mun ahi lo na sih nading mun gamdang ah nang leh na pianna na nu kong lawnkhia ding hi.
A ciahkik nopna gam ah amaute a ciahkik ngei kei ding uh hi, a ci hi.

Hih mipa pen a kideih lo-a kipai a kitam tamzan pasian Conyah (Yahyakin) hilo ahi hiam? Amah pen a sungah hoihna a omlo beel hi lo ahi hiam? Bang hangin amaute in amah leh a suan a khakte lawnkhia-in a theih ngei lo gamah kipaai ahi hiam?
Leitung, leitung, leitung aw, Yahweh’ kammal za in!

Yahweh in hih bangin gen hi: A nuntak sungin ama za a luah ding a nei lo, taselpa-in hih mipa lai sungah gelh in; bang hang hiam cihleh ama suante khat beek David kumpi-tokhom tungah tu lo ding a, Yahdah gam sung zong a uk kei ding hi.
“Ka lonona mun-a tuute susia-in a thehthang tuucingte in gimna ngah tahen!” Yahweh in ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Israyl’ Pa Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Ka mite an a pia tuucingte tungah gen in: “Note in Ka tuuhonte thehthangin, na notkek mang uh a, na vil kei uh hi. En un, na siat gamtatna uh hangin note kong en gige ding hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.
Ahi zongin amaute ka notkhiatna gam khempeuh panin Ka tuuhon a omlaisunte ka kaikhawm ding a, a buk ah ka ciahpih kik ding hi; amaute cipha-in a pung ding uh hi.
Amaute an vakin a don dingin tuucingte ka koih ding a, amaute lau nawn loin, zong maimial lo ding uh a, kisap zong a nei kei ding uh hi, Yahweh in kong ci hi.

En un, Yahweh in kong cih inah, Keimah in David suan panin a thumaan Hiang khat ka khangsak ding hun, Kumpi khat in ukin, gualzo ding a, leitung ah thumaan leh thutang tawh thu a khen ding hun tung ding hi.
Ama hun sungin Yahdah kihonkhia ding a, Israyl lungmuang takin teng ding hi; Amah in amaute tungah a tangko ding Min in: ‘Yahweh Tsidqenu; YAHWEH EITE THUMAANNA’ ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en un, Yahweh in kong cih inah, amaute in, ‘Egypt leitang panin Israyl mite hong paikhiatpih Yahweh a nuntak mah bangin,’ ci-in kiciam nawn loin,

amaute in, ‘Kepcingna mun pan leh amaute ka hawlkhiatna gam khempeuh panin Israyl innkuan guite paikhiatpih-in a makaih Yahweh a nuntak mah bangin,’ ci-in kiciam zaw-in, amau gam mahmah ah a ten ding hun hong tung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Kamsangte hangin ka sungah ka lungsim kithamzan a, ka guh ka tang a liing hi. Zu in a zawh gawp mi khat bangin, Yahweh hang leh Yahweh’ kammal siangthote hangin zu kham gawp ka bang hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh gam sungah angkawmte; pasiante nung zui dingin Yahweh zuihna panin a kihei khiate, dim hi. Hih hamsiatna hangin leitang kap a, gamlak lono munte keucip hi. Amaute gitlohna lam ah pai uh a, a thu neihna uh a man loin a zang uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh kamsangte leh siampite a nih tuakin zahtak nei loin gamta uh hi! Hi hi, Ka Inn sung nangawn ah amau gitlohna ka mu hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amau aa dingin a lampi uh lam nal hi ding a, khuamial ah pai-in, khuamial sungah a puk ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau dantatna hun ciangin amau tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Samaria kamsangte lakah a muh thadahhuai ka mu hi: amaute in Baal suangin kamsang uh a, Ka mi Israyl-te lam a pialpih uh hi.

Yerusalem-a kamsangte lakah zong a mulkimhuai thu ka mu lai hi: amaute angkawm-in zuau gamtat uh hi. Gamtatsiate’ khut khauhsak lai uh hi; tua ahih ciangin a gitlohna uh panin kuamah a kiheikik kei uh hi. Kei aa dingin amaute khempeuh Sodom tawh kibang uh a, a khua sunga tengte Gomorrah tawh a kibang hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih kamsangte tawh kisai-in vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En un, Keimah in amaute gamsai tawh ka vak ding a, gutui ka dawnsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yerusalem kamsangte-a pat mun khempeuh ah thuman lohna hong kizel hi.

Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Note tungah thu hong gen kamsangte thu ngai kei un! Amaute in note hong lamen khialsak uh hi. Amaute in a lungsim ngaihsut tawmna thu hong gen uh a, Yahweh’ kam pan hilo hi.

“Yahweh in, ‘Nopna na ngah ding uh hi,’ ci khin hi,” ci-in Kei hong simmawhte tungah gen ngitnget uh hi. Amau lungsim deihna bangin a gamta a kuamapeuh tungah, “No tungah siatna hong tung lo ding hi!” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh’ kuppihna sungah amaute lak panin kua ding ngei-in, mukhia-in, a kammal za ngei ahi hiam? Amaute lakah kua in a thu ciamteh-in za takpi ngei ahi hiam?
En un, a thuakhak mahmah pingpei, Yahweh’ pingpei heh mahmahna tawh hong kipankhia khin a, migilote’ lutung ah nasia takin hong tusuk ding hi.
A lungsim sunga a tupna teng semin a tangtunsak matengin Yahweh’ hehna veng lo ding hi! Hun nunung nite ciangin kician takin na tel ding uh hi.
Hih kamsangte ka sawl lohpi-in tai uh a, amau thu ka gen lohpi-in kamsang uh hi.
Ka kuppihna sungah amaute ding a, Ka kammalte Ka mite a zasak uh hileh, a gilohna panun kikhelin, a gamtat siatna uh panin kihei khin ding uh hi.
A gamla-a omte Pa hi loin, a nai-a omte Pa bek ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
Ka muh loh nadingin mun simtham ah a kibu thei kua om ahi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi. Vantung leh leitung a dimsak Keimah hilo ka hi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
Keima Min tawh zuau thu kamsangin, “Mang ka man hi! Mang ka man hi!” ci-in kamsangte’ genna ka zakhin hi.
Zuau thu a gen kamsangte’ lungsim sungah hih thu bang tanvei om lai ding ahi hiam? Hi hi, amaute pen amau lungsim ngaihsut tawm tawh thu a gen kamsang zuaute ahi uh hi.
A pu a pate un Baal; Topa, hangin Ka Min a mangngilh bang tektekun, miteng tungah a gen kawikawi uh amau mangmatnate hangin Ka mite Ka Min mangngilhsak theih nadingun a ngimte ahi hi.
Mang a man kamsang in a mang gen hen! Ka kammal a nei mipa in muanhaui takin Ka kammal gen hen! Buhtang tawh thehkak dingin buhtu bang hi lel ahi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
Meikuang tawh kibangin, suangtum a seekzan sek tawh a kibang Ka kammal hilo ahi hiam? Yahweh in ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en un, Ka kammalte khat tung panin a gusawn kamsangte langkhat ah kei ka pang hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
En un, amau phuahtawm thu gen napi, “Hih bangin Yahweh in ci hi,” a ci kamsangte langkhat ah ka pang hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

En un, a man lo mangmatna thu a gen mite langah kei ka pang hi, Yahweh in ci hi. Kamsangte in gen uh a, amau zuau thu leh phamawhsak a neih lohna uh hangin Ka mite lam a pialsak uh hi! Keimah in amaute ka sawl kei a, thu zong ka piak ahi kei hi! Hih mite aa dingin phattuamna a nei nawn peuhmah kei uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih mite ahi a, kamsangte ahi a, siampite in ahi zongin, “Yahweh’ vangik bang ahi hiam?” ci-in nang hong dot uh ciangin, amaute kiangah, “Note pen vangik na hi uh a, kong lawnkhia ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi,” ci-in na gen ding hi.
“Yahweh’ genkholhna kammal in vangik hi,” hong ci kamsang ahi a, siampi ahi a, mipi ahi zongin Keimah in tua mi leh a innkuanpihte ka dantat ding hi.
Note in na vengte khatpeuh, na sanggamte khatpeuh kiangah, “Yahweh in bangin hong dawng ahi hiam? Yahweh’ gen bang ahi hiam?” na ci ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin “Yahweh’ vangik,” cih thu na gen nawn kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kamsangte Genna tungtawnin mite tungah thu tunga—ahih hangin note in a nungta Pa, vanglian Yahweh i Pa kammal na na lumlet gawp uh hi.
Kamsangpa kiangah hih bangin na dong ding uh hi: Yahweh in bangin hong dawng ahi hiam? ahih keileh Yahweh in bang thu gen ahi hiam?

Note in, “Yahweh’ vangik’ na cih uh leh, Yahweh in kong gen inah: no tungah kong sawl lai-in, “Yahweh’ vangik” ci-in gen kei un, kong ci a, ahih hangin note in ‘Yahweh’ vangik’ ci-in gen na hih manun,
En un, Kei, Kei mahmah in kong mangngilh taktak ding hi; note hong taisanin, note leh na pu na pate uh tungah kong piak khuapi leh nomau mahmah Ka omna panin kong lawnkhia ding a,
note tungah a kimangngilh ngei lo ding tawntung kosiatna leh maizumna ngitngetna kong thuaksak ding hi.

Babylon kumpii Nebuchadnezzar in Yerusalem panin Yahyakim’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yeconyah(Yahyakin) leh Yahdah uliante, khut siamte leh siksek siamte, Babylon ah salin a paikhiatpih khit ciangin, Yahweh in kei hong lak hi; en un, Yahweh’ munsiangtho mai-ah theigah bawm nih kikoih hi.
Bawm khat sunga theigahte, theigah min masate tawh kibangin limci mahmah hi; ahih hangin adang bawm khat sunga theigahte pen limci het loin nek theih ding ahi kei hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in kei kiangah, “Yeremyah aw, bang mu na hi hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, “Theigahte, a limci mahmah theigahte leh a limci het lo, nek theih loh zah dong dingin a sia theigahte mu ing,” ci-in ka dawng hi.
Yahweh’ kammal kei tungah hong tung leuleu a,

“Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: Yahdah panin salin a kipaikhiatpiih mite, amau phattuamna ding mahin hih mun panin Cheldea mite’ gam sungah ka sawlkhiatte tungah hih theigah limcite mah bangin ka ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a hoihin amaute ka en ding a, hih leitang ah amaute ka paipihkik ding hi; amaute ka lam ding a, ka phel kei ding hi; amaute ka suan ding a, ka botkhia kei ding hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in Keimah Yahweh ka hihna hong theih nadingun amaute tungah lungsim khat ka pia ding hi. A lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Kei kiangah hong kileh ding uh ahih manin amaute pen Ka mite hi ding a, Kei pen amaute Pa ka hi ding hi.

Tua hi a, a taktakin Yahweh in kong cih inah, Yahdah kumpi Zedekyah leh a uliante, hih gama a omsuak Yerusalem-a omlai sunte leh Egypt gam sunga a tengte, limci lo lua ahih manin nek theih nawn ding ahi lo theigah siate bangin ka bawl ding hi.
Amaute ka hawlkhiatna mun khempeuh ah natthuak ding, mi notgawp ding, kosiatna leh paunak, zahkona leh hamsiatna-a zat dingin leitung kumpigam khempeuh ah ka pia ding hi.
Keimah in amaute leh a pu a pate uh tungah ka piak leitang panin a beitum matengun amaute lakah namsau, kialpi leh pulpi ka sawl ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Babylon ah Nebuchadnezzar kumpi a suah masak kum, Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yahyakim ukzawh a kum lina kumin Yahdah mi khempeuh tawh kisai-in Yeremyah tunga a tung thu hih bang ahi hi:
Kamsang Yeremyah in Yahdah mite khempeuh tung leh Yerusalem-a tengte khempeuh tungah a gensawn hi;

Amon’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yoshiyah uk zawh a kum sawm le thumna kum-a kipan tuni mahmah dong—kum sawmnih le kum thum sung—kei tungah Yahweh’ thu hong tung a, tua ciangin note kong hopih a, thobaih-in kong gen hi; ahih hangin note in na ngai nuam kei uh hi!

Tua hi a, Yahweh in note tungah Ama nasem kamsangte khempeuh hong sawl a, zingsang tuung mahin amaute sawl a, ahih hangin note in na ngai nuam kei uh a, na zak nadingun na bil uh zong na ngat nuam kei uh hi.
Amaute in, “A kuamapeuh na gitlohna pan leh a gamtat siatna uh panin tu-in kihei leuleu unla, Yahweh in note tung leh na pu na pate tungah a tawntunga neihsuak dingin hong piaksa gam sungah teng un;

Tua hi a, a kikham pasiante’ na sem ding leh a bia dingin a nung zui kei un! Nomau khuta na bawl tawm nasepnate; (elohim, teraphim), tawh Kei hong hehsak kei un! Tua ciangin Keimah in note hong nasak kei ding hi!
Tua hi napi-in ote in Ka thu nong ngai kei uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi; na khuta na bawl tawm nasepnate tawh Kei nong hehsak uh a, nomau mah a kinasak tawm na suak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Note in Ka thute ngai lo na hih manun,

En un, leilu lam minam khempeuh ka sawl ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi: bang hang hiam cihleh ka khutzat Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar ka sawl ding a, hih gam leh a sunga tengte leh a kiimkot-a hih minamte khempeuh langpangin amah ka puak ding a, amaute ka susia kiuhkeuh ding a, mite kih, zahkona-a zat leh tawntunga siacip dingin ka bawl ding hi.
Tua bek tham loin, lungdamna aw leh kipakna aw, zi nei thakpa aw leh monu aw, angawina ging leh meivak tangte ka beisak ding hi.
A gam buppi-in gamtul leh gam simtham suak ding a, hih minamte in Babylon kumpipa’ na kum sawmsagih sung a sem ding uh hi.

Hici bangin hong piang ding hi: kum sawmsagih a bit ciangin Keimah in Babylon kumpipa leh tua gam (Chaldea mite’ gam), amau mawhna hangin ka dantat ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi: tua hi a, tawntunga kinusia cip dingin ka bawl ding hi.
Tua gam langpanin ka gensa Ka thute khempeuh tua gam tungah ka tungsak ding hi—minam khempeuh tawh kisai-in Yeremyah in a kamsansa, hih laibu sunga kigelh khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi.
(Bang hang hiam cihleh minam tampi leh kumpi liante in amaute zong sila-in zang ding uh a, amau gamtatsate tawh kizui leh, amau khutin a sepnate tawh kizui-in amaute ka thuk kik ding hi.)
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in kei kiangah hih bangin hong gen hi: “Ka khut sung panin hih hehna leenggahzu hai la inla, nang kong sawlna minam khempeuh dawnsak in.
Tua ciangin amaute lakah ka sawl namsau hangin amaute in dawnin, hoi dangdangin a hai ding uh hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin keimah in Yahweh’ khut panin tua hai ka la a, Yahweh in kei hong sawlna minam khempeuh ka dawnsak hi:
Yerusalem leh Yahdah khuapite, a kumpite leh a uliante, tuni-a mah bangin kisia-in, mite kih, zahkona-a zat leh hamsiatna ahi dingin ka dawnsak hi.
Egypt kumpi Pharaoh, a nasemte, a uliante leh a mipite khempeuh;
gamdang mi kigawm a vekpi: Uz gam kumpite khempeuh, Philistine gam kumpite khempeuh, a min-in: Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, leh Ashod-a omlai sunte;
Edom, Moab leh Ammon mite;
Tyre kumpite khempeuh, Sidon; Phoenicia, kumpite khempeuh, leh tuipi gal khat-a om tuipi dung gam kumpite;
Dedan, Teman, Buz leh a ba-sam metkolhte khempeuh tawh;
Arabia kumpite khempeuh leh sehnel gama teng a kihelzau mipi kumpite khempeuh;
Zimri kumpite khempeuh, Elam kumpite khempeuh leh Medes kumpite khempeuh;

Khat le khat a kinai, a gamla-a leilu lam kumpite khempeuh leh lei maitang-a om leitung kumpite khempeuh ka dawnsak hi. Amaute khempeuh khit ciangin a dawn ding Sheshach; Saltan ma-in Babylon cihna-in simgenna-in a zat kammal ahi hi, kumpipa zong ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, “Vanglian Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin ci hi: Note lakah kong sawl namsau hangin dawn unla, kham un; lua un! Puk unla, thokik nawn kei un, ci hi,” ci-in gen in.

Hih bang hong hi ding hi; amaute in a dawn dingin na khut panin hai hong lak nop kei uh leh, tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, ‘Vanglian Yahweh in: na dawn ngeingei ding uh hi! ci hi,’ na ci ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh en in, Ka Min tawh a kisam khuapi tungah siatna tunsak ding ka kipan hi; tua ahih ciangin note in dantahna thuak peuhmah lo ding na hi uh hiam? Leitung-a tengte khempeuh tungah a tung dingin namsau khat ka sam ding ka hih manin dantahna thuak loin na om kei ding uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute langkhat-a kamsanna hih thute khempeuh amaute kiangah gen in; a sangna panin Yahweh hawk ding a, a siangtho a tenna mun panin Ama aw gingkhia ding hi; Ama tenna tungah thakhauh takin hawk ding hi; leenggah cil mite bangin leitung-a tengte khempeuh langkhat ah awngkhia ding hi.
Aw ging in leimong dong thawn ding hi—bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in minamte langkhat ah pang hi. Amah in mi khempeuh thusit ding hi; migilote pen namsau tungah kipia ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi.
Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: En un, siatna in minam khat panin minam khat zuan ding a, leitung mun tawpnate panin pingpei khauh mahmah hong kipan ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Yahweh thahte leimong khat panin mong khat dong hi ding hi. Amaute kikah lo ding a, zong kikaikhawm loin, a kivui kei ding hi; leilak ah amaute a ki-ek nusiat ding hi.

No tuucingte aw, kap unla, tau un! No tuuhon makaite aw, leivui lakah kikhuk un! Bang hang hiam cihleh note hong kithah lup ni ding leh note kithehthang ni ding uh hong tung ta hi. Note na puk ding uh a, beel hoih kimlai a kitamzan tawh na kibang ding uh hi.
Tuucingte tai nading om lo ding a, tuuhon makaite suahtak theih nading om lo ding hi.
Tuucingte’ kahna aw leh tuuhon makaite’ tau-na aw kiza ding hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amau gancinna mun susia khin hi.
Yahweh’ heh mahmahna hangin a lungnophuai tenna munte kisiacip hi.
Amah in humpinelkai bangin a bukna mun taisan hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a Nengniampa’ heh mahmahna leh Ama sinso luatna hangin amau gam kisiagawp hi.
Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yahyakim’ uk a kipat hunin, Yahweh kiang panin hih thu hong tung hi:

Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Yahweh’ Inn a tual lah ding inla, Yahweh’ Inn ah a bia dingin hong pai Yahdah khuapite khempeuh tungah, amau tunga gen dingin kong thupiak kammalte khempeuh gen in. Mal khat zong siit kei in.
Amaute in na thugen ngai-in amau gamtat siatna panin kihei kha thei ding hi; tua hileh amau gamtat siatna hangin Keimah in amaute tunga tung dingin ka geelsa suksiatna ka tungsak nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Note mai-ah ka koih Ka Thukham zuih nadingin Ka thu nong ngaih kei uh a,
note kiangah thobaih-in kong sawl ahih hangin amau thu na man ngei loh uh, Ka nasem kamsangte thu na thusim kei uh leh,
Hih Inn Shiloh ka bangsak ding a, hih khuapi leitung minam khempeuh aa dingin samsiatna ka suaksak ding hi!” ci hi, ci-in gen in.
Tua ahih ciangin siampite leh kamsangte leh mipi khempeuh in Yahweh’ Inn sungah Yeremyah’ gen hih thute a za uh hi.

Mi khempeuh tungah gen dingin Yahweh in amah thu a piak hih kammalte khempeuh Yeremyah in a gen khit phetin hih bangin hong piang hi; siampite leh kamsangte leh mipi khempeuh in amah man-in, “Na si taktak ding hi!

Bang hangin Yahweh’ Min tawh kamsangin, ‘Hih in Shiloh tawh kibang ding a, hih khuapi kuama ten lohna gamkhing suak ding hi,’ ci na hi hiam? a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn sungah mi khempeuh in Yeremyah langah a pangkhawm uh hi.
Yahdah uliante in hih thute a zak ciangin kumpi inn panin Yahweh’ Inn ah pai to uh a, Yahweh’ Inn Kongpi Thak lutna ah tu uh hi.

Tua ciangin siampite leh kamsangte in uliante leh mi khempeuh kiangah thu genin, “Hih mipa a si dingin kilawm hi! Bang hang hiam cihleh nomau bil mahmah tawh na zak uh mah bangin amah in hih khuapi langpanin kangsang hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yeremyah in uliante khempeuh tung leh mi khempeuh tungah thu genin, “Na zaksa uh thu khempeuh tawh hih Inn leh hih khuapi langpanin kamsang dingin Yahweh in kei hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, na zia na tong uh puahpha unla, Yahweh na Pa uh thu mang un; tua ciangin Yahweh in note langkhat ah a gensa siatna amah in hong tungsak lo ding hi.
Kei ka hihleh, en un, note khut sungah ka om hi. Kilawm kituak na sak bangun hong bawl un.

Ahih hangin limtaka na theih ding uh thu in: Kei nong thah uh leh, nomau tung mahmah, hih khuapi tung leh a sunga tengte tungah mawhbaang lo sisan a tun na suak taktak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note zakin hih thute khempeuh a gen dingin kei hong sawl taktak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin uliante leh mi khempeuh in siampite tung leh kamsangte tungah, “Hih mipa in Yahweh i Pa min tawh eite tungah thu hong gen ahih manin a sih ding kilawm lo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangn gam sung upate pawl khat dingto-in, a kikhawm mi khempeuh tungah thu genin, a gen inah:

“Moresheth khua-a Micahyah in Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah hun lai-in kamsang a, Yahdah mi khempeuh tungah thu genin, ‘Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Lo khawh bangin Zion kikho ding a, Yerusalem a kisia zan ding hi; Yahweh’ Inn omna mual tung gamlaka mualte tawh kibang ding hi,’ ci hi.

Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah leh Yahdah mi khempeuh in amah that zuzen ahi uh hiam? Hezekyah in Yahweh zahtak loin, Yahweh zong lo ahi hiam? Yahweh in amaute langkhat ah a gensa siatna dokkik lo ahi hiam? Ahih hangin eite in ei tung mahmah ah siatna lianpi i tungsak dekdek hi!” a ci uh hi.
Kiryath Yearim khua-a Shemayah’ tapa Uriyah zong Yahweh’ Min tawh kamsang mi khat hi a, amah in Yeremyah’ kammalte tawh a kibang pianin hih khuapi leh hih gam langkhat ah kamsang hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Yahyakim, a mi thahat khempeuh leh a uliante in a thugente za uh a, kumpipa in thah dingin a zong hi; ahih hangin Uriyah in hih thu a zak ciangin lau-in tai a, Egypt ah a bu hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi Yahyakim in Egypt ah mi sawl a; a minin Achbor’ tapa Elnathan leh amah a zuite tawh Egypt a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Egypt panin Uriyah manin, kumpi Yahyakim kiangah puak uh hi; amah in namsau tawh thatin, mi mawkmawkte kivuina han ah a luanghawm a paai hi.
Ahih hangin Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam in Yeremyah panpih ahih manin thah dingin mite khut sungah amah kipia lo hi.
Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Zedekyah uk a tung lamin, Yahweh kiang panin Yeremyah tungah hih thu tung hi:
Yahweh in kei tungah hong gen thu hih bang ahi hi: Nomau aa dingin savun khau leh hakkol bawl inla, na ngawng ah bulh in.
Tua ciangin Yerusalem-a Yahdah kumpi Zedekyah kianga hong pai taangmite tung tawnin Edom kumpipa, Moab kumpipa, Ammon mite’ kumpipa, Tyre kumpipa leh Sidon; Phoenicia, kumpipa tungah thu zasak inla,
a gam-ukte tungah gen dingin thupia-in, “Vanglian Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in hih bangin gen hi—hih in na gam-ukte tunga na gen ding uh ahi hi:
Keimah in Ka khut zankhia-in a lian mahmah Ka vangliatna tawh leitung leh lei-a om mihing ganhing ka bawl a, piak tuak ka sak pen tungah ka pia hi.
Tua hi a, tu-in Ka nasem Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar khut sungah hih gamte khempeuh ka piakhin hi; ama na a sem dingin gamlak gamsate zong ama tungah ka pia hi.
Tua ahih manin sehsa hun a bei mateng minam khempeuh in amah leh a tapa leh a tupa’ na sem ding a, tua ciangin ama gam in adang minam liante leh kumpi liante’ na sem ding hi.

Hici bangin hong piang ding hi: Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar’ na a sem lo, Babylon kumpipa’ hakkol a pua lo minam leh kumpigam peuhmah ama khut tawh ka beisak matengin namsau, kialpi leh pulpi tawh dan ka thuaksak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin no tungah thu hong genin, ‘Babylon kumpipa’ na na sem kei ding uh hi!’ a hong ci na kamsangte, na aisan theite, na mangman theite leh na khut lam en theite’ thu ngai kei un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in note hong hawlkhia-in na gam uh panin a gamlapi ah hong hemkhia-in note na mangthan nadingun amaute in no tungah zuau thu a hong kamsang ahi uh hi.

Ahih hangin a na sepsak dingin Babylon kumpipa’ hakkol nuai-ah a ngawng a dawh minam peuhmah Yahweh in kong cih inah: amau gam sung mah ah ka omsuak sak ding a, amaute in tua lai-ah lo kho-in a sungah teng ding uh hi, ci-in gen in,” hong ci hi.
Hih thute khempeuh tawh kizui-in Yahdah kumpi Zedekyah tungah zong thu ka gen a, “Babylon kumpipa’ hakkol nuai-ah na ngawng dawh in! Amah a mite’ na sem inla, nungta in!
Babylon kumpipa’ na a sem lo ding minamte tungah Yahweh’ gensa bang tektekin bang hangin namsau, kialpi leh pulpi tawh nang leh na mite si ding na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin no tunga thu hong genin, ‘Babylon kumpipa’ na na sem kei ding uh hi!’ a hong ci kamsangte thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in no tungah zuau thu a hong kamsang uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in amaute ka sawl kei a, tua hinapi-in amaute in Ka min tawh zuau thu kamsang uh hi, Yahweh in ci hi; tua ahih ciangin Keimah in nang kong hawlkhia ding a, nang leh nang tunga thu hong gen kamsangte na mangthang khawm ding uh hi, ci hi” ka ci hi.

6 Siampite leh hih mite khempeuh tungah zong thu genin, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: No tunga kam a hong sangin, ‘En un, Babylon panin Yahweh’ Inn-a vanzatte kipuakik dek ta ding hi,’ a hong ci na kamsangte uh thute ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in no tungah zuau thu a hong kamsang uh hi!
Amau thu ngai kei un! Babylon kumpipa’ na sem unla, nungta un! Bang hangin hih khuapi kisia zenzen ding ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin amaute kamsang hih uh a, Yahweh’ thu amau tawh om ahih leh, tu mahmah-in vanglian Yahweh tungah thumna bawl uh hen; tua hileh Yahweh’ Inn sung, Yahdah kumpipa inn sung leh Yerusalem khua-a om lai sumngo vanzatte zong Babylon ah pai lo ding hi.

tuate pen Yahyakim’ tapa Yahdah kumpi Yeconyah (Yahyakin) pen Yahdah leh Yerusalem-a mi thupite khempeuh tawh Yerusalem panin Babylon ah a kipaipih lai-in Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a lak lohte ahi hi—
